name: NipaPlay-Reload
body:
## 新功能

- **iPhone Duo 适配** ([#1058](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1058))
  手机端界面适配 iPhone Duo。系统要求竖排导航时，标签栏改为贴在侧边的竖排液态玻璃胶囊，页面操作按钮（主题、设置等）竖排在摄像头和状态栏下方，内容会避开这一列。内屏（regular 宽度）下，主页、媒体库、账户页改为双列显示。其他 iPhone、iPad、Android 和桌面端的布局不变。
- **双语内嵌字幕“整块”显示模式** ([#1050](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1050))
  针对双语内嵌字幕轨新增整块显示模式。从字幕菜单挂载或移除外挂 ASS 时，字幕可见状态会自动同步，避免出现挂载后不显示、移除后重复显示的情况。关联：[#990](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/990)
- **Erika 内核支持外挂 ASS/SSA 与字幕样式** ([#1070](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1070))
  Classic 使用 Erika 内核时，外挂 ASS/SSA 交给内核用 libass 绘制，滚动、卡拉 OK、渐变等特效得以保留。字幕颜色、描边、阴影、粗体斜体、对齐和边距等样式设置也会传给 Erika。SRT/VTT 仍使用应用内叠层。目前 Erika 暂不支持字幕高度和阴影颜色，字幕延迟也尚未接入。
- **新版媒体信息页 LiquidGlass 按钮** ([#1073](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1073))
  新版媒体信息页适配了 LiquidGlass 按钮，在支持的设备上默认开启，可在“设置 - 外观”中关闭。同时修正了“弹幕偏移”设置处两处互相矛盾的功能说明，并更新了内置正则插件。

## 体验改进

- **弹幕透明度改为线性生效** ([#1038](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1038))
  此前 Flutter 渲染的弹幕会把透明度平方后再绘制（设为 70% 时实际只有约 49%），与 Erika 原生弹幕和 ASS 导出不一致。现在所有渲染路径都直接使用设置值。已将透明度调低的用户升级后会发现弹幕比以前更不透明，可按需重新调整滑块。
- **离线时可使用过期的弹幕缓存** ([#1055](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1055))
  新番弹幕缓存过了新鲜期后保留 30 天才清理。联网获取失败时（需要登录的错误除外）会回退到保留的缓存，离线重看已看过的集仍有弹幕。在线时照常重新拉取。关联：[#1024](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/1024)
- **WebDAV 搜索提速，局域网发现失败可见** ([#1049](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1049))
  WebDAV 搜索改为有界并发，并对请求发起间隔限速。局域网发现失败时会给出可见提示，不再静默。关联：[#1013](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/1013)
- **WebDAV 认证增强** ([#1051](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1051))
  字幕下载支持挑战式认证（含 Digest），并正确处理重定向，凭证只发往连接自身的源。配置了用户名和密码的 WebDAV 连接，其媒体播放会经本地认证代理，匿名连接仍直链。带空格或中文文件名的 Digest 认证也已修正。关联：[#1027](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/1027)
- **macOS 上 MDK 使用 App 自带的 libass** ([#1040](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1040))
  之前装了 Homebrew libass 的机器上，MDK 会加载系统里的版本。现在固定使用

name: magpie
body:
## Features
- Added the Antigravity desktop app as a row, wired through its gateway setting.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed the contributors table to stay within phone width.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`

Thanks to ryougi\_hachi, whose reports and code went into this release. Everyone who helped: [contributors](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/contributors).

<!-- lang:zh -->

## Features
- 将 Antigravity 桌面应用添加为一行，并通过其网关设置进行连接。

## Bug Fixes
- 修复了贡献者表格，使其保持在手机宽度范围内。

### 安装

从 [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai) 下载，或运行 `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`。已安装的 magpie 会自动更新。

感谢 ryougi\_hachi：这次更新里有你的反馈与代码。所有贡献者见[贡献墙](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/zh/contributors)。

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**remove-ai-slops now names the two Bun scripts the programming skill ships for test work.** Phase 2 runs `check-test-junk.ts` over every in-scope test file and treats its `file:line` findings as category-9 candidates (never automatic cuts); Phase 4b names `mutation-proof.ts` as the command behind the serial apply/run/restore proof it already described. ([#12017](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12017))

**The programming skill ships two Bun scripts that make the test rules mechanical.** `check-test-junk.ts` flags the junk classes a regex can see in touched test files (source greps, prose pins, fixed sleeps, `.only`/`.skip`, self-comparisons, lower-bound cardinalities) with a per-line opt-out, and `mutation-proof.ts` breaks a production owner, runs the named tests, restores the file byte for byte and prints red/green, so "test your test" is one command. ([#11972](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11972))

**remove-ai-slops now prunes junk tests with the same table the programming skill and the gate reviewer use.** Category 9 marks every in-scope test R/F/C/D, proves each deletion or merge by its class's rule (a production mutation for the behavior classes) before the cut, keeps the retention bar, and reports a baseline-red test as a bug instead of deleting it; behavior is locked with gate-passing tests rather than change certificates, and the report carries a Tests Ledger. ([#11968](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11968))

- senpi-task: a message sent to a daemon task while its launch is being recorded keeps its input identity; the task record no longer rolls its `effect_seq` back, and a record rewritten to the same size is no longer read stale (#10708). ([#11946](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11946))

- Internal telemetry maintenance. ([#11882](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11882))

### Fixed

- `omo remote attach` on Windows now reports a stopped OmO device se

name: dsh-our-free-model
body:
## 非官方社区构建 / Unofficial community build

这不是仓库作者发布的官方安装包。作者自 2.4.0 起将桌面安装包限制为 Windows-only，Mac 用户停留在 2.3.0。本 dmg 由本仓库的 GitHub Actions 从公开源码构建，可审计、可复现。

This is NOT an official release by the repository author. The author restricted desktop installers to Windows-only since 2.4.0, leaving Mac users on 2.3.0. This dmg is built by GitHub Actions from public, auditable source.

| 项 / Item | 值 / Value |
|---|---|
| 版本 / Version | 2.7.1 |
| 架构 / Arch | arm64 |

### 可信性 / Trust

1. 构建来自当前标签对应的公开源码，可逐行审计。
2. 本 dmg 正是你正在查看的这次 Actions 运行的产物，由 GitHub macOS runner 构建；任何人 fork 后重跑同一 workflow 即可复现。
3. 下载后请核对下方 SHA256。

### 「已损坏」/ "damaged" 怎么办？/ How to open

本包未经 Apple 签名与公证（社区构建没有 Apple Developer 账号），Gatekeeper 会拦截首次启动，并非文件损坏。任选其一：

The package is unsigned / not notarized (a community build has no Apple Developer account), so Gatekeeper blocks first launch. The file is NOT damaged. Pick any one:

1. 访达中右键（Control 点按）应用图标 → 「打开」→ 再次确认。In Finder, Control-click the app → Open → confirm again.
2. 终端清除隔离属性 / remove the quarantine attribute:



3. 仍提示损坏时用 sudo / if it still complains:



4. 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 「仍要打开」。System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

name: FModel
body:
# FModel

## 2026 Update & Recap
To close out the year, a new update has just been released, and it replaces the thing you stare at the most: **the 3D viewer**.
The old viewer served us well, but it had reached its limits. Its replacement has been in development for 1.5 years and is now its own standalone project:
<https://github.com/FModel/Snooper>

### Newly added
- A **brand new 3D viewer** that loads faster and runs better, to a degree that isn't even comparable to the old one. Its structure is much closer to UE, making it a true scene explorer rather than a mesh preview
- Better support for instanced SMs/SKs, HISMs, lights, and environment components
- Preview and export support for BPs, `Houdini Static Mesh`, and `IRMesh`
- DBD procedural maps can be previewed and exported, with seed generation
- Option to export files embedded in UE payloads (`.hda`, `.swf`, `.wem`/`.bnk`)

### Bug Fixes and Improvements
- Far more accurate material guesses. Enabling `Serialize Inlined Shader Maps` in the settings improves accuracy even further, at the cost of slightly slower loading
- Animation retargeting is now accurate, and texture swizzling is detected automatically
- **USD** materials are more PBR friendly, while **glTF** can now embed materials and exports faster
- `PNG` now exports 2x faster for only 15% bigger files, with new compression settings for `PNG` and `TGA`
- Massively faster folder tree navigation, plus faster texture export that uses less memory (@LongerWarrior )
- Many other bug fixes and new supported games from previous updates (@LongerWarrior @Masusder)

### Notes
- Snooper requires a GPU with **OpenGL 4.6 and bindless texture support** (iGPUs work too)
- It's a brand new renderer, so expect some rough edges, and please report them

To get the latest version of FModel and experience these improvements, download the update from here https://fmodel.app/download or check for updates within the application (Help > Releases).

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.23

本版本让 Kimi Code、MiniMax Code、Oh My Pi 的供应商编辑器按应用自己的格式显示配置文件里这一家的部分；Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式和 Gemini 的上游时，客户端选的思考档位能发给更多模型，卡片上还可以选怎么发；授权中心可以一键刷新所有账号的额度；Antigravity、MiniMax Code 的用量记录有了耗时和首字时间。另外修复了 Windows 上进入轻量模式后主窗口回不来、经路由连部分 OpenAI 格式的上游时切换模型失败、DeepSeek Harness 的配置目录是链接时无法编辑供应商、Grok Build 超过 50 MiB 的会话用量不统计、Codex 分支会话用量一直不导入、DeepSeek Harness 等应用测试官方余额时提示 Key 为空、供应商表单里几个编辑器互相覆盖等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.23-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.23-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Kimi Code、MiniMax Code、Oh My Pi 的供应商编辑器按原生格式显示

以前这三个应用的供应商编辑器显示的是卡片的 JSON，和它们实际的配置文件对不上，上游文档里的配置片段也贴不进来。现在编辑器只显示配置文件里这一家的部分，位置和格式都和文件一致：

- **Kimi Code**：`config.toml` 里的 `[providers.<key>]` 和它的 `[models."..."]` 表。
- **MiniMax Code**：YAML 里的 `custom_provider.<key>`。
- **Oh My Pi**：`models.yml` 里的 `providers.<key>`。

标题显示实际的文件路径，会跟着目录覆盖和 `KIMI_CODE_HOME` 这类变量变化。草稿有格式错误、写了别家的节点、或者写了 `default_model` 这类全局设置时会提示并拒绝保存，改好之前上方的表单字段暂时不能改，避免把草稿覆盖掉。在编辑器里写的注释不会保存。DeepSeek Harness 的供应商在 profile 补丁里，仍用 JSON 编辑器。

### 经路由连 Gemini 时，思考档位也能发过去

以前 Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由转成 Gemini 原生格式时，客户端选的思考档位和「关闭思考」都被丢掉，Gemini 一律用模型的默认设置。现在按 Gemini 自己的 OpenAI 兼容接口的换算方式发：

- **Gemini 2.5**：低、中、高分别是 1024、8192、24576 的思考预算。关闭思考时 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 发 0，Pro 不能关，发最小的 128。
- **Gemini 3 及以后**：发 low、medium、high 档位（Gemini 3 Pro 没有 medium，发 high）。这些模型都不能关闭思考，关闭时发支持的最低档。
- 认不出的模型、图片和语音这类模型、名字里已经带档位的中转别名（如 `gemini-3-pro-high`）不发，请求里本来没有思考设置时也不发。

### 授权中心「全部刷新」

授权中心页头多了「全部刷新」按钮，一次重新查询页面上所有账号的额度（DeepSeek 是余额），各行照常显示更新中（[#9073](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9073)）。

## 改进

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
This release fixes XeMFG generating only part of the time in Red Dead Redemption 2 on D3D12, makes a freeze on Vulkan games much harder to reach when the game loses focus, and adds a frame rate limit and two experimental options for Vulkan. The freeze is not fully fixed: see [Known limitations](#known-limitations).

## XeMFG backend

- **Fixed: Red Dead Redemption 2 on D3D12 generated in only some frames.** The game evaluates DLSS ahead of its Presents, so some Presents had no frame and up to 40% of frames went out without generation. The addon now keeps a queue of frames for this order. In the field session, no frames went without generation after the first 10 seconds.
- **Vulkan: losing focus freezes the game far less often.** Alt-tabbing or clicking away makes the host rebuild its swap chain, and the NVIDIA driver can stop there for good, which froze the game. The freeze also happens in 1.7.0. While the chain is rebuilt, XeMFG now drops frames instead of waiting for it, and it no longer builds a chain for a minimized window. Expect a short hitch when you return to the game.
- **Vulkan: frame rate limit.** The output follows the game's Reflex limit and **Limit to display refresh**. The panel shows **Output limited to** when a limit applies.
- **Vulkan: more robust device and swap chain handling.** Input views and private data are released with their device and swap chain, a DLSS evaluation is no longer lost while the frame acquisition sleeps, another live device no longer blocks the inputs, and `IMMEDIATE` is used only where the surface offers it. The compatibility report now covers Vulkan and the reason a game went back to its own swap chain.
- **Fixed: a fence wait could end early.** After a timed-out wait, a late completion could end the next wait on another value, with a command allocator still in use.

## [4.29.4] - 2026-10-31

### 新增

- 消息按钮：新增跨平台按钮组件，支持链接、消息发送和插件回调，并提供交互超时提示。各平台支持的按钮类型以文档为准。 (#9809)
- 决策模型：新增独立于聊天模型的 Decision Provider 和 System One 适配器，供插件调用结构化选择、布尔判断和评分。 (#10775)
- 网络搜索：接入 SerpApi Google News，支持新闻来源、作者、发布时间和 WebUI 引用展示。 (#10773)
- 会话与用户选择：统一会话来源选择弹窗，支持昵称搜索、平台标识、分页及 ID 复制；记录发送者信息并补全飞书、QQ 官方群名称。管理员配置入口由“添加更多 → 编辑列表项”改为“选择用户”；原会话下拉框和列表编辑入口统一为“选择会话来源”，“已知会话”改为“已记录的会话来源”。 (#10747)
- 机器人管理：删除机器人时可选择清理配置、定时任务、会话、消息记录、追踪和用量数据；默认保留对话与历史数据。 (#10761)
- 定时任务：支持查看群内共享任务列表，并允许管理员删除群任务。 (#10785)
- 网络设置：新增 PyPI 镜像选择器与测速功能。 (#10657)

### 优化与修复

- 稳定性：修复日志输出受阻时 WebUI 和 WebChat 可能无响应的问题，并在诊断包中提供控制台日志丢弃统计。 (#10902)
- 上下文压缩：简化设置，将“历史记录达到上限或上下文窗口紧张时的处理方式”改为“压缩策略”，“上下文压缩模型提供商 ID”改为“压缩模型”；最大轮数、丢弃轮数、压缩指令、近期上下文比例及回退窗口大小移至“更多设置”，保留现有配置和运行行为。 (#10753)
- 模型服务：保留 Anthropic 兼容服务所需的 API Key 请求头；修复 DashScope Agent 超时配置未生效的问题。 (#10787, #10868)
- Gemini：提供原生参数快捷模板，并修正原生工具配置提示。 (#10771, #10875)
- 插件与技能：修复 NAS 等环境中临时目录与 `.astrbot` 标记文件冲突导致的插件安装失败；报告插件配置重载失败；加载技能时优先使用文件读取工具。 (#10784, #10788, #10789)
- 安全：为默认 PyPI 镜像启用 TLS 证书校验。 (#10685)
- 音频：支持带 `0x03` 前缀的腾讯 SILK 音频。 (#10744)
- ChatUI：文件面板使用当前会话的工作目录。 (#10883)
- WebUI：优化追踪列表实时更新、统一配置表单样式、移除自定义规则中不受支持的“全部”选项，并限制原生滚动条样式仅在 Firefox 生效。 (#10748, #10755, #10757, #10760)

- Web search: Integrated SerpApi Google News with publisher, author, publication time, and WebUI citations. (#10773)

Why don't skeletons fight each other? Because they don't have the guts 🤣

## BentoPDF Is One Year Old! 🎉

I didn't realize this. The [first release of BentoPDF, v1.0.0](https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/releases/tag/v1.0.0), went out on **20 October 2025**, which means BentoPDF is now **one year old**! I'm so thankful to every one of you who used it, shared it, reported bugs, translated it and sent PRs. None of this would have happened without you. ❤️

### Also I need your support to keep going

BentoPDF has grown into a lot more than one tool, but behind it there is still **just one core maintainer: me**. Every feature, every engine, every bug fix, every PR review and every issue reply goes through one person, and keeping this pace up on my own is getting really hard.

**Your support goes directly into:**

* **BentoPDF**, with faster releases and faster fixes
* **[Kura](https://www.bentopdf.com/kura)**, our PDF standards and preflight engine
* **[Hyper Compress](https://www.bentopdf.com/hyper-compress)**, our compression engine
* **BentoParse**, our new document parsing engine
* **Hiring a second core maintainer** to work full time on BentoPDF, so the project no longer depends on just one person

**Here's how you can help:**

1. **Sponsor on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/alam00000).** Monthly sponsorships make the biggest difference, even small ones, because they let me plan ahead. You can also chip in once on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/alio01).
2. **Advertise on bentopdf.com.** The homepage now has a sponsor section right above the tools. The last time we had analytics, bentopdf.com was getting around **20,000 views a day**, and it's very likely more now (we removed Simple Analytics, so we can't say for sure). Ads are plain logos and links: no tracking, no scripts and no pop-ups, and **self-hosted copies never show them**. Book a slot at [bentopdf.com/advertise](https://www.bentopdf.com/advertise)

body:
### 修复

- EarFun Air Pro 4+ 等耳机只走传统蓝牙 SPP 控制，EncoDeck 不再为它们保持 LE 链路：此前即使在 Windows 和耳机里关闭了 LE Audio，EncoDeck 仍会维持 LE 连接，首页显示“LE Audio”，耳机断开时还会提示等待 LE Audio。现在只有 Windows 真正为这副耳机提供了 LE Audio 输出时才显示 LE Audio（[#16](https://github.com/TIANLI0/EncoDeck/issues/16)）。
- EarFun 耳机回报的设置值带有额外字节时不再被忽略。

- Enco X4 / X3 切换到 LE Audio 后不再走传统蓝牙：双耳 LE 配对完成后删除 Windows 自动生成的传统蓝牙配对，只保留 LE 配对。此前传统链路会在 LC3 旁边反复建立，经典 A2DP 可能抢在 LE Audio 端点出现之前接管声音（切换显示失败、需要多试几次），或者 LE 链路被反复打断、控制通道不停重连。之后再次出现的传统配对也会自动删除；EncoDeck 按原来的设备身份继续识别耳机，设置不丢失。
- 切换到 LE Audio 时等待 LE Audio 播放端点的时间由 20 秒延长到 30 秒，Intel 智音技术适配器注册端点较慢时不再误报失败。

name: clash-nyanpasu
body:
> 简体中文版本请展开页面底部的「简体中文」。

## Read Before Upgrading

- **With TUN on, the TUN stack chosen in Clash settings now takes precedence over a Profile's `tun.stack`.** Previously a stack written by the subscription won. If you relied on it, choose the stack in settings instead (the default is gVisor).
- **A Profile that sets a TUN stack the selected core rejects now fails to apply, with an error naming the value and the supported ones.** For example, `tun.stack: mixed` or `mips` under Clash Premium, which would otherwise make the core reject the whole config. This is checked even while TUN is off, because the core parses the key on load. Values Nyanpasu does not know are still passed to the core.
- **The stack selector only lists the stacks the current core reads**, and is hidden for clash-rs and Meow, which ignore the key. If the saved stack is not supported by the core you switch to, gVisor is used and a warning is written to the log; the saved setting is kept.
- **Service mode now requires nyanpasu-service 2.0.2.** An installed 2.0.1 service is upgraded once at startup. 2.0.2 fixes a stale pid record that made the service and the app fail on every start (#6033).

## Highlights

- **Mips (Mihomo IP Stack)**, mihomo's new user-space TUN stack, can be selected under mihomo and mihomo-alpha, together with its TCP congestion controller (CUBIC, Reno, BBR, BBRv3, or the core default). The controller is remembered when you switch to another stack and back (#6091).
- **Startup failures no longer crash the app.** A dialog names the file, the cause and the recovery steps, and can open the containing, backup or log folder. Corrupt local data and an unusable jobs journal are rebuilt instead of blocking startup.

## [2.0.1] - 2026-10-31


### ✨ Features

- **config:** Add the mips TUN stack and its congestion controller (#6098) by @greenhat616  in [#6098](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6098)

- **config:** Decide the TUN stack from each core's config features (#609

    -   **Root Session Suffix Normalization**: Solves the 100% Prompt Cache miss issue caused by multi-agent frameworks (such as Cindy, AutoGPT, LangGraph) frequently deriving transient sub-session UUIDs during plan steps. Implemented `extract_root_session_id` within `SessionScope::resolve` to automatically strip derived suffixes (`:step:N`, `:subtask:...`, `:agent:...`, `:talk:...`, `--step-N`, `::`); the affinity routing key converges to the root session to lock the upstream account and restore sub-second TTFT caching, while the store key preserves the complete sub-session ID for isolated thinking storage. (Fixes #3789, Thanks to @Ran-Xing)
    -   **Credential-Level Affinity (AffinityScope::ApiKey)**: Extended `StickySessionConfig` with an affinity scope toggle, supporting seamless switching between `session` (default) and `api_key` modes to lock all requests under the same API token to a single account with automatic failover on 429 or quota exhaustion; supported headless override via `ANTIGRAVITY_SCHEDULING_AFFINITY_SCOPE`. (Fixes #3789)
    -   **Contextual UI Pill Toggle & 12-Locale Support**: Added an intuitive pill toggle in the Scheduling configuration panel within ApiProxy settings, fully localized across all 12 supported languages. (Fixes #3789)
-   **[Remember Login Credentials in Web/Docker Mode] (Fixes #3791, PR #3792, Thanks to @cubelikeplayDaniel)**:
    -   **Optional Credential Persistence**: Added an optional "Remember login credentials" checkbox to the Web/Docker login dialog, disabled by default to maintain shared device security; persists API Key to `localStorage` upon successful authentication, eliminating redundant re-logins on browser restart. (Fixes #3791, PR #3792, Thanks to @cubelikeplayDaniel)
    -   **Request Fallback & 401 Listener Lifecycle Fix**: `request.ts` now prioritizes `sessionStorage` with graceful fallback

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. Clearer clean output: Rows for large folders now say what they hold, such as "4 simulators" or "8 builds, May to Aug", with the name linked to the folder instead of a command to copy; empty rows are gone, waits show a spinner, the first line of a dry run appears in 0.22s instead of 2.31s, and the result reads "Removed: X · N items". 2. Browser and Adobe caches kept while in use: Chrome and Brave caches wait until the browser quits, and Adobe's media cache waits while Premiere Pro, After Effects or another Adobe video app runs. 3. Downloaded models and running AI sessions are safe: `mo clean` no longer treats llama.cpp's downloaded models as a cache, and keeps an older Claude Code, cursor-agent or Copilot release while a session still runs on it. 4. Mail attachments you edited stay: Only attachment copies nobody touched after Mail saved them are cleaned, instead of everything older than 30 days. 5. Spotlight keeps your switches: `mo optimize` no longer turns Show Related Content back on. 6. Faster start on a crowded temp folder: Mole lists the system temp folder once a day, so `mo --version` took 0.15s instead of 1.89s on one Mac. 7. Progress for a large Trash: Emptying the Trash shows a count like 1200/16919 instead of a spinner that looks stuck. 8. More caches covered: The Yarn Berry global cache and BrowserOS caches are cleaned, and owner commands such as `npm cache` and `pnpm store prune` show the space they actually freed. 9. Honest uninstall summary: Moving an app to the Trash no longer says the space was freed, and the Docker hint points to `docker system df -v` for per-volume sizes. ### 更新日志 1. 清理结果更清楚：大文件夹的行会直接说明里面有什么，比如「4 simulators」「8 builds, May to Aug」，名字可以点开对应文件夹，不再让你复制命令自己跑；0B 的行不再显示，等待时都有加载动画，d

name: airi
body:
## v0.14.1 Highlights

A small patch release. It fixes model downloads, makes the mobile app nicer to use, and gives the IO tracer a full rebuild.

### Bug fixes

- **Voiceprint enrollment on desktop no longer needs a download.** Before, enrollment could fail with only `fetch failed` when the voiceprint model could not be fetched from Hugging Face. The desktop app now ships with the model, so enrollment works offline from the first try.
- **Failed model downloads now tell you what went wrong.** Before, a failed download showed a raw error such as `fetch failed`. It now shows a plain sentence, for example that the connection failed, the server returned an error, or the download stopped early. Each failed model also has a **Retry** button, so you don't need to restart anything. The voiceprint settings page on Web and mobile shows the same explanation.
- **The Android app stops asking for the microphone on every visit.** Before, Settings > Hearing showed "Allow microphone access" each time you opened it, even after you had allowed it. The picker now lists your microphones right away. If you have not allowed access yet, it opens the system dialog for you.
- **The mobile stage no longer shows a stuck hearing error.** With Listen on and no speech recognition provider, a status pill above the composer showed an error that never went away, even when nothing was listening. The composer microphone and voice presence already show your input state, so we removed the pill.

### Product updates

#### Mobile

- The composer is a little narrower while idle, so more of your character shows. It widens again when you start typing, attach an image, reply, or join a call.

#### Voice

- Voice draft problems no longer squeeze the draft. Before, an error appeared as a red line that made the draft area smaller and made a working draft look broken. You now see a small warning icon with a count, and you can hover over it to see the list. Microphone and wake word problems n

# GitHub Stars Manager v0.8.9

## ⚡ Urgent Fix / 紧急修复说明

- **EN**: This is an early hotfix release for a critical Windows issue: after the window was fully covered by another window, restored from the system tray, or the monitor layout changed, the window could stop repainting and appear completely frozen ("dead") even though the app was still running. We are shipping this version ahead of schedule so everyone can get back to normal use as soon as possible.

### 1. Critical Windows Fix / Windows 窗口假死紧急修复 (#534)
- **EN**: Fixed the Windows "frozen window" issue where the window stopped receiving new frames after being fully occluded, restored from the tray, or when the monitor configuration changed. The fix adds forced repaint, compositor (BeginFrame) liveness detection, and a main-process reload fallback when the focused window keeps receiving no frames (#534, fixes #533).

body:
此更新修复了部分用户近期无法登录 Apple 账户的问题，并包含以下改进：

- 使用 Apple 当前服务配置返回的认证地址，不再依次尝试可能已经失效的旧地址。
- 修复 Apple 认证地址缺少末尾斜杠时可能返回空响应或无效跳转的问题。
- 正确处理 Apple 登录过程中的 301、302、307 和 308 跳转。
- 登录跳转后继续保留 SAP 签名请求、Cookie、双重认证验证码和认证次数，避免商店令牌换取失败。
- 兼容 Apple 服务配置中认证地址位于根级或 `urlBag` 内的两种格式。
- 限制并验证认证跳转目标，避免将账户凭据发送到非 Apple 地址。

建议所有用户安装此更新。

name: Apollo-Reborn
body:
### Performance

- Send fewer Reddit requests on **API-Key-Free** accounts by not repeating link preview lookups for sites that block previews and by briefly reusing the Inbox's reply lookups, so ordinary reading reaches Reddit's rate limit later (#1579: @icpryde)
  - New replies, and anything you post or edit, still refresh right away

### Fixes

- Fix **multi-photo posts** showing a reddit.com link and 0 photos since Reddit began marking their photos as failed, so the gallery, feed carousel, media viewer, Save All and Gallery View show them again (#1589: @icpryde)
  - Covers galleries posted from Apollo with Reddit as the Media Upload Host and from other apps; they show as square cards in the feed
- Fix **API-Key-Free search** showing "Error searching" or "Error loading subreddits" for post search, searching within a subreddit or multireddit, and subreddit search (#1557: @DeltAndy123)
- Fix **All Posts (r/all)** showing "Couldn't load posts" on **API-Key-Free** accounts, for every sort and with Exclude Subscriptions (#1570: @icpryde)
  - All Posts has another way in before Old Reddit, and if Reddit blocks another **API-Key-Free** read, a route update can work around it without an app update (#1594: @DeltAndy123)
- Open the feed you chose to start on again at launch by turning **Restore Reading Session** off by default; it moves to Posts & Feeds → Feed (#1511: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - A choice you changed yourself in 4.0.0 is kept, so turn it back on there if you relied on the 4.0.0 default
- Fix a crash when opening a **post or comment link** while Reddit is rate-limiting requests, most often right after returning to Apollo; the usual "Error loading comments" banner shows instead (#1572: @icpryde)
- Fix the **home screen icon** turning into iOS's generic grid after installing or updating Apollo with an alternate icon selected (#1554: @icpryde)
  - Apollo re-applies your icon once on the first launch after the update, so iOS shows its "You have changed the icon" alert

name: Archon
body:
Upgrading from 0.13.0 with providers installed works in one command again.

### Fixed

- `archon provider add` and `archon plugin update` now replace a maintained provider installed by 0.13.0, whose receipt declares the older plugin protocol, including several providers in one command. On 0.13.1 they refused, saying the executable "may belong to a plugin whose receipt cannot be read", so the documented upgrade step failed and workflows that used that provider stopped loading. A file with an unreadable receipt or a different plugin ID is still refused, and the existing repair for a provider's own malformed receipt is unchanged. (#5287)
- `archon isolation cleanup` help and the CLI reference describe the container threshold as age since the environment was created, which is what cleanup uses. (#5283)
- The source-install guide points to the Bun version the repository pins instead of `>= 1.0.0`. (#5275)

### Quick Install (Recommended)

**macOS / Linux**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://archon.diy/install | bash
```

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" ghcr.io/coleam00/archon:latest workflow list
```

name: UniGetUI
body:
# Devolutions UniGetUI 2026.3.3

This release lets you add your own installers to the Software Catalog, adds Extensions starting with Git Repositories, lets you choose package list columns by right-clicking the header, and asks for confirmation before uninstalling or ignoring several packages. It also fixes many WinGet, PowerShell and Scoop update bugs.

### New Features
* The Software Catalog can now offer installers: .exe and .msi on Windows, and .pkg, .dmg and .zip on macOS. They are served from a shared folder or a web folder and can be installed, updated and uninstalled like any other package
* The Catalog Editor is now hidden behind its own setting, under Settings > Experimental
* Added Extensions in Settings, starting with Git Repositories. It keeps your local Git clones up to date on their default branch and shows their worktrees and branches. Extensions are off by default.
* You can now choose which columns a package list shows by right-clicking its header. Changes apply right away.
* Added an optional Release date column to package lists.
* You can update an ignored package once from **Manage ignored updates**, and it stays ignored afterwards.
* Scoop can now install a specific version.
* Added a Release notes item to the right-click menu on Software Updates.
* `unigetui://package` links now open a package's details.
* You can now hide the tray icon while UniGetUI keeps running in the background.
* Added an option to quit UniGetUI once automatic updates have finished.

### Improvements
* UniGetUI now asks for confirmation before uninstalling packages, and before ignoring updates for several packages at once.
* On first launch, package managers whose tool isn't installed are now turned off, and pages say when no package manager is available instead of reporting that everything is up to date.
* Cargo no longer needs `cargo-binstall` or `cargo-update`.
* `update-all` and `update-manager` commands now work in headless mode.

name: vorssaint-utils
body:
### Summary
More reliable window switching, audio, screenshots and display recovery, with safer file handling and app removal. New options include an all-windows shortcut, Claude account selection, scroll-to-zoom, a Quit apps panel and more flexible calendar countdowns.

### Added
- The window switcher has an optional All windows shortcut that cycles through individual windows across apps in every layout, including Large icons. Settings → Window switcher → All windows. Thanks to BrainAPP for the suggestion.
- AI Agents can select an existing Claude Code account profile and show the monitored account. Local usage and plan limits follow the selected profile. Settings → Dynamic Island → Content → AI Agents → Claude account.
- Dynamic Island level controls and the menu panel's mixer can be adjusted with a mouse wheel or trackpad. Thanks to @JB-OD.
- Dynamic Island can start event countdowns 15, 30, 60 or 120 minutes before an event and keeps longer countdowns fully visible. Thanks to @Aryan-Saini.
- An optional Pinch Zoom feature turns a modifier and mouse-wheel movement into pinch gestures in supported apps, with a choice of modifier and scroll exceptions. Thanks to @ahmadhatahet.
- An optional Quit apps panel can request normal quits for one app, all apps or all except the current app, with a saved list of apps to keep running. Thanks to @thedankest.
- Command Bar converts days, weeks and fixed 365-day years, with English and Portuguese unit names. Thanks to @asim-sde.
- Settings backups can be exported or imported with `--export-settings FILE` and `--import-settings FILE`; importing requires the app to be closed. Thanks to @DrakeEvans.
- Clipboard history can show source app icons in list view. The option starts off and preserves file icons and selection controls. Settings → Clipboard history → Show source app icons in list view. Thanks to @ywu73.
- Dynamic Island can show a volume row below the music player. Settings → Dynamic Island → Content → Music → Show volume

# Release Notes - RepoStore v1.0.22

**Release Version:** `v1.0.22`  
**Version Code:** `23`  
**Release Date:** October 29, 2026  

---

### Highlights & Key Improvements

#### 🚀 Resilient APK Downloader & "Failed to get file info" Fix
- **Eliminated Fatal Pre-flight Abort**: Fixed an issue where clicking the "Install" button would immediately fail with *"Failed to get file info"*. Pre-flight `HEAD` and Range probes are now treated as non-blocking optimizations. If a server, CDN, or proxy rejects or times out on `HEAD` requests, the downloader automatically falls back to standard single-part `GET` streaming.
- **Added Required Network Headers**: Added an OkHttp interceptor injecting `User-Agent: GitHubAppStore-Android` and `Accept: */*` across all requests, preventing HTTP 403 Forbidden responses from GitHub release endpoints and anti-bot filters.
- **Mirror Proxy Resilience**: If a selected mirror proxy is down, unreachable, or times out, the download automatically falls back to the direct GitHub release URL.
- **Multi-Part to Single-Part Fallback**: If multi-threaded chunk downloading encounters mid-stream connection issues, it automatically falls back to single-part streaming to guarantee successful download.
- **System DownloadManager Safety Net**: Added automatic fallback to Android's system `DownloadManager` in `AppInstaller` if parallel downloading fails.

#### 📦 Scoped Storage & Modern Android Compatibility (Android 10 - 16)
- **App-Specific Download Storage**: Saved APKs are now stored in `context.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)` (with fallback to app cache directory). This eliminates `EACCES (Permission denied)` errors on Android 10+ without requiring broad storage permissions.
- **Clean FileProvider Integration**: Seamless URI generation via `FileProvider` ensures the system Package Installer can always read and install the downloaded APKs.

#### 🎨 Material 3 UI & Dialog Refinements
- **Theme Selection Cards**:

name: motrix-next
body:
## What's Changed

This beta routes the app's own downloads through the engine, so updates download like any other download. Quitting from the tray no longer freezes the app, the close dialog can remember your choice, and the add window opens torrents at their final size.

### ✨ New Features

- **Close action** — the close dialog has a "Remember my choice" option, and General settings sets what the close button does: ask, minimize to the tray or quit (#778)

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Downloads through the engine** — update packages and metadata, remote `.torrent` files, tracker lists, the BT blocklist and ED2K bootstrap lists are downloaded by the engine with multiple connections and the configured proxy; update packages are verified with the updater signature before install. When the engine is not running, the app downloads them directly (#775)
- **Update dialog** — the status icon uses a tinted status color instead of a fixed green background

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the app freezing when quitting from the tray or Dock; quitting now waits for the engine and services to stop without blocking the window system (#774)
- Fixed the add window growing abruptly when opened with a torrent file, and the form emptying while the window closes

### 📦 Downloads

| Platform | Architecture          | File                      |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------------------------- |
| macOS    | Apple Silicon · Intel | `.dmg`                    |
| Windows  | x64 · ARM64           | `-setup.exe`              |
| Linux    | x64 · ARM64           | `.AppImage` `.deb` `.rpm` |

WWPlayer WINDOWS「v1.3.8」

## 新功能
- 个人中心新升级，观看记录、统计云端同步。
- 聚合收藏升级，新增演员收藏。
- 播放器新增画面调整，支持移动、缩放和拉伸画面，调整应用于同一季。
- 服务器图标支持圆形显示。
- 本地、SMB、WebDAV、OpenList 和网盘支持同目录文件连播，已匹配剧集可按真实季集顺序播放。但在未刮削下仅能独立续播，并不能参与到聚合继续播放或详情页中。

## 优化
- 升级下一集预加载，复用已准备的播放信息和媒体缓存，减少自动连播与手动切集的等待。
- 剧集信息新增连载、完结状态及播出年份范围。
- 资源详情补充 Dolby Vision Profile、层信息及 HDR 兼容格式。
- 优化时间轴预览采样与 ToDB 图集适配。
- 优化服务器在线状态检测和线路延迟显示。
- 选择观影感受后自动发射。
- 细节优化。

## 修复
- 修复完整缓存播放跳转后，旧连接未释放导致画面卡住的问题。
- 修复部分片尾结束后自动切集因暂停请求超时而失败的问题。
- 修复自动裁边失效，以及音轨、字幕轨道名称显示不完整的问题。
- 修复部分模块搜索结果剧集归组错误、无法取得正确目录的问题。
- 修复外置 mpv 失败原因提示不完整，以及退出后无法再次播放的问题。

- 支持关闭主窗口后收起至托盘，保留投屏会话、独立窗口和未保存的按键映射草稿；默认关闭此选项。
- 改进五种语言、浅色与深色主题下的大字号布局、滚动条、固定关闭按钮、键盘导航和辅助功能资源。
- 优化原画虚拟摄像头的颜色转换、USB 解码回读和帧队列，改善 60 fps 输出；OBS 建议启用视频采集设备缓冲。

### 修复

- 修复 USB 控制停止与重试的资源竞争、多设备恢复枚举、解码器候选回退和慢启动等待。
- 完善 Cryptex/Personalized DDI 回退及媒体认证健康检查，避免失效连接继续报告控制就绪。
- 修复无线宿主清理、启动失败退避、DLNA 降级恢复，以及 HLS 异常退出被误判为播放完成。
- 录制文件发布失败时保留已完成成品，支持保存重试和重启恢复，防止后续录制覆盖未保存文件。
- 修复精简模式全屏尺寸、设置面板中的 F11/Esc、蓝牙 F9 输入切换、更新交接和音频欠载恢复。
- 改进 Apple USB 支持安装的日志失败重试、首次设置恢复、设备绑定及并行媒体输出状态。
- 应用与驱动管理器版本统一为 1.8.5-pre4。

### 验证范围

自动构建执行原生、Python、应用逻辑、驱动及本地化检查；GitHub 托管环境跳过需要交互桌面的 WPF 运行时测试。
本地记录包含五语界面、安装与卸载、真实 USB 投屏和控制及原画虚拟摄像头验证。单台设备的性能结果不代表所有设备；无线控制仍受 RemotePairing 凭据限制，未计为通过。详细范围见仓库内 2026-10-28 至 2026-10-29 的验证文档。

### Added

- Add Japanese localization across the app, driver manager, installer, and related tools, with Japanese font selection.
- Add optional close-to-tray behavior that preserves projection sessions, independent windows, and unsaved keyboard mapping drafts; disabled by default.
- Improve large-text layouts, scrollbars, fixed close buttons, keyboard navigation, and accessibility resources across five languages and both themes.
- Optimize native-resolution virtual camera conversion, USB decoder readback, and frame queues for smoother 60 fps output. Enable video capture device buffering in OBS for best results.

### Fixed

- Fix USB control stop/retry ownership, multi-device recovery enumeration, decoder fallback candidates, and slow-start readiness waits.
- Improve Cryptex/Personalized DDI fallback and media authentication health checks so failed sessions cannot keep reporting control readiness.
- Fix wireless host cleanup, startup backoff, DLNA degraded recovery, and HLS failures incorrectly reported as successful playback completion.
- Preserve completed recordings when publication fails, allow save retries and recovery after restart, and prevent overwriting unsaved recordings.
- Fix compact-mode full screen,

name: BS2PRO-Controller
body:
这是 2026-10-29 的预发布版本，包含自 v3.7.3 正式版以来的更新。
This preview includes changes since the v3.7.3 stable release.

## 更新亮点 / Highlights

- **Linux BS2 Pro USB 通信修复（#45）**：识别已知的无编号 USB HID 描述符，修正输出报文前缀及长度。正常控制、灯效和调试命令共用修正后的封装。
- **Linux BS2 Pro USB communication fix (#45)**: recognize the known unnumbered USB HID descriptor and correct output framing and length for control, lighting, and debug commands.
- BS1 新增 USB HID 通道；BLE 广播不带设备名时，使用服务 UUID 回退匹配（#46、#47）。
- BS1 USB HID support, plus service-UUID fallback when BLE advertisements omit the device name (#46, #47).
- 桌面端迁移到 Wails v3，改进实时遥测渲染、后台开销、Windows 全局快捷键和 Win11 贴靠布局支持。
- Desktop migration to Wails v3, with improvements to telemetry rendering, background overhead, Windows global hotkeys, and Windows 11 Snap Layout support.

## 修复与改进 / Fixes and Improvements

- HID 读取遇到 `Interrupted system call` 时重试，避免将信号中断计为连接故障。
- Retry interrupted HID reads instead of counting signal interruptions as connection failures.
- 补充 #45 原始 USB 状态报文的回归测试；硬件测试要求收到对应命令的有效回复，避免把异步状态上报误判为查询成功。
- Add regression coverage using the USB capture from #45; hardware tests require matching command replies rather than accepting unsolicited status notifications.
- 温度桥接组件在 Intel GCL 崩溃后跳过 GCL 初始化重启，并修正日志调用位置记录。
- Restart the temperature bridge with Intel GCL initialization skipped after a GCL crash, and correct log caller locations.

## 验证状态 / Validation

- GitHub Actions 的 Linux、Windows 检查及发布包构建均已通过。
- Linux and Windows CI checks and release-package builds passed.
- #45 的 BS2 Pro Linux USB 修复仍待报告者真机确认，本预发布不代表该设备问题已确认解决。
- Confirmation of the BS2 Pro Linux USB fix on the reporter's hardware is still pending; this preview does not establish that the reported issue is resolved.

[完整变更 / Full changelog](https://github.com/TIANLI0/THRM/compare/v3.7.3...nightly-20261029)

本次修复提交 / Fix commit: [67091d5](https://github.com/TIANLI0/THRM/commit/67091d5dea620f06585e5793b1f1eab68c96746e)

name: Twilight_Echo
body:
# Twilight Echo 1.4.0-perview0 更新说明

本次版本是自 `1.3.1` 以来的大型架构与体验升级版本：完成了统一共享内核（Twilight Core）与多端可移植运行时演进，重构了 DSP 音频工作台与持久化 SQLite 音乐库，新增公共资料智能识别、2D/3D 外观工作区，并集中修复了 WASAPI 独占输出切换、ASIO 自动缓冲、本地日文/OTF 字体解析与歌词字体同步等多项关键问题。

---

## 1. 架构升级：统一共享内核（Twilight Core）与多端运行时

- **统一共享内核收敛**：将曲库、播放会话、队列、搜索、歌单、书签、歌词、均衡器/DSP、远程投射、统计与设置收敛至统一的共享内核（`src/core/`），主进程、渲染器与独立音频服务通过强类型命令协议与因果状态投影通信（#181, #193, #201）。
- **独立可移植运行时（`music-core.js`）**：新增可独立打包的 ES2017 / QuickJS 兼容内核构建与宿主桥接层（`portableEmbeddedHost`），支持嵌入式自定义流式音源读取（Seekable Host Inputs）、音频设备桥接与歌词同步。
- **跨平台与移动端底层适配**：新增 Android AAudio / Oboe / JNI 输出后端、iOS AudioUnit 输出后端，以及 Android 串行 JavaScript Provider 插件运行时与插件仓库工具链。
- **局域网遥控与多设备互联**：局域网遥控网关扩展 `/api/core/rpc` 与 `/api/core/events` 接口，支持受信任设备发现、配对管理与媒体桥接。

---

## 2. 音频引擎、DSP 工作台与独占输出修复

- **DSP 工作台与参数均衡器重构**：
  - 重整音频工作台界面（信号检测、路由、输出设置、场景监测与参数均衡器控件），播放进度条支持 2000 点高精度分析波形展示。
  - 扩展重采样相位配置、目标采样率策略与 DSD512 调制支持；补充音频回调负载、削波统计、响度范围与静音边界实时遥测。
  - 修复 DSP 旁路（Bypass）状态保持问题，以及调整均衡器时 IPC 载荷无法结构化克隆的报错（#167, #177）。
- **WASAPI 独占模式与故障恢复**：
  - 修复 WASAPI 独占模式下播放中应用设备档案必定报 `output_target_not_ready` 并触发回滚的问题，为 WASAPI Exclusive、CoreAudio（共享/独占）与 ALSA 补齐 `outputInfo.actualDeviceId` 上报及路由回退匹配（#198, #203）。
  - 修复旧音频子进程退出前未静音导致部分 USB DAC 驱动残留占用、以及将 `AUDCLNT_E_DEVICE_IN_USE` 误判为采样率/位深格式不支持的问题；新增占用进程检测与 Core 音频故障恢复面板（#185, #195）。
  - 修正 WASAPI 独占模式下 PCM 与 DoP 输出的区分判定逻辑（#170, #171）。
- **ASIO 与 Linux 平台修复**：
  - 为 ASIO 自动缓冲引入采样率感知的下限保护（Rate-aware Auto Buffer Floor），并在欠载率偏高时给出明确告警（#180, #184）。
  - 修复 Linux MPRIS 桌面媒体控制状态同步问题（#188）及音乐文件夹递归监听问题（#187）。

---

## 3. 音乐库、智能资料识别、曲库健康与搜索

- **持久化 SQLite 曲库与大曲库窗口化**：
  - 本地曲库集合、流派、标签、Focus 筛选、评分与探索视图全面迁移至持久化 SQLite 服务（Schema 29，含旧音频文件发行日期增量回填与任务取消/恢复保护）。
  - 支持十万级大曲库窗口化流畅浏览、外部歌单导入与队列编辑。
- **音乐资料与公共音源智能识别**：
  - 新增艺术家详情页与集成资料管理；支持公共资料源、艺术家与录音交叉核验、专辑子集识别及 NCM 文件身份解析。
  - 优化后台刷新期间的艺术家编辑态保持与公共缓存稳定性。
- **曲库健康诊断与个人备份**：新增曲库健康诊断与重复曲目/收件箱处理流程；完善首次导入引导及设置/个人资料备份恢复。
- **统一搜索与当前曲目定位**：引入搜索相关性排序与拼写纠错；桌面端各歌曲列表、主页、最近播放、流媒体歌单及网络音乐源统一支持「定位当前播

body:
# foo_ui_webview2 v2.1.0

This release adds features and fixes bugs; it replaces 2.0.0 directly. See the [changelog](https://nereafantasia.github.io/foo_ui_webview2/changelog) for every change.

## Before you upgrade

A few behaviours changed. Themes that rely on them need an update:

- If your page multiplies the rectangles it passes to `window.setDragRegions`, `window.setNoDragRegions` or `window.setClickThroughExcludeRegions` by a zoom factor, remove that step. The host now converts them with the page's `devicePixelRatio`, which already includes page zoom and the Windows text size.
- `fb-playlist-view` no longer treats the Chinese column names for play count, first played, last played, date added and rating as column IDs. Use `play_count`, `first_played`, `last_played`, `added` and `rating`.
- A panel whose URL override points at a remote site must be allowed in the panel configuration before the page can call the API. URLs entered before the upgrade stay allowed.
- `pathsUnavailableReason` from `dnd.getCapabilities` no longer lists `displaced`, which the host never reported. TypeScript code that compares against it fails to compile; delete the comparison.
- `initialized` from `library.getStatus` now tells whether the library finished loading at startup. It used to repeat `enabled`.
- `menu.runMainMenuCommand` with a slash-separated path must match every parent menu; a wrong prefix no longer falls back to a leaf command of the same name. Running a dynamic leaf by GUID needs both `guid` and `subGuid`.
- `sampleRate` and `channels` from `audio.generateFullWaveform` and `audio:fullWaveformReady` now report the format the decoder actually outputs, which can differ from the file's nominal values.

## New

- Incremental library sync: `library.getChanges` returns a revision that survives restarts and the changes after it, and `library.getTracks` fetches rows by handle, so a page can keep its own copy of the library. Library events carry `handles` and `truncated`, and `l

```bash
docker pull docker.io/bestzwei/libretv:2.21.1
```

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

cd libretv && PASSWORD=your-password PORT=8080 node server.js
```

预构建包与 CPU 架构无关（x86_64 / arm64 / armv7），环境变量与 Docker 部署一致。

body:
-   **[Web/Headless Update Settings 400 Fix & Partial Patch Merge Governance] (Fixes #3754)**:
    -   **Dual-Shape Request Body Compatibility for Axum Admin API**: `POST /api/system/updates/save` now accepts both the `{"settings": {...}}` wrapper forwarded by the frontend `invoke` mapping and the flat JSON used by Headless/CLI clients, permanently fixing the deterministic 400 Bad Request (content-length: 0) when switching to the Beta channel or toggling auto-check in Web mode. (Fixes #3754)
    -   **Update Settings Now Apply as Partial Patches**: Introduced `UpdateSettingsPatch` and `patch_update_settings` so only explicitly provided fields are overwritten; omitted fields (`last_check_time`, `update_channel`) retain their persisted values. This root-cause fixes the silent channel reset to the build default when toggling auto-check, and the last-check timestamp being zeroed on every save. (Fixes #3754)
    -   **Error Propagation & Empty-Patch Guard**: Persistence failures now surface as 500 with an error body, and empty patches return 400 with the list of expected fields, eliminating the previous `let _ =` silent-success path. (Fixes #3754)
    -   **Unified Semantics Across Web and Desktop**: The Tauri command now uses the same patch semantics; the frontend drops the hardcoded `last_check_time: 0` and submits only `update_channel` when switching channels. (Fixes #3754)
    -   **Regression Test Coverage**: Added unit tests for wrapped/flat payload parsing, unknown-field empty-patch detection, patch field preservation, and empty-patch rejection. (Fixes #3754)

---

-   **[Web/Headless 更新设置保存 400 修复与局部补丁合并治理] (Fixes #3754)**:
    -   **Axum 管理接口请求体双形态兼容**: `POST /api/system/updates/save` 现同时接受前端 `invoke` 映射透传的 `{"settings": {...}}` 包装体与 Headless/CLI 的平铺 JSON，彻底修复 Web 端切换预览版通道或修改自动检查更新时必然返回 400 Bad Request（content-length: 0）的问题。(Fixes #3754)

body:
# v2.7.2 插件发布

本次只发布插件，桌面安装包和独立产品版本保持原状。

## 修复旧版升级路径

此前旧升级器最多接受 80 个文件、每个文件最多 4 MiB，而 2.7.1 清单有 93 个文件，并包含约 65 MiB 的引擎。无论换哪个下载源，旧用户都会在读取清单时失败。

2.7.2 基于最新主线，将省 Token 模块合并为生成文件，引擎 gzip 压缩后拆成 9 个不超过 4 MiB 的分片。插件清单共 79 个文件，旧版可直接升级，无需先安装过渡版本。引擎首次启动时只读取本地分片，分别校验分片、压缩体和最终可执行文件摘要，按声明的解压上限还原到独立缓存；不从网络补取代码。

发布构建会拒绝超出旧版文件数量或体积预算的内容。历史升级器回归夹具直接取自 1.3.1、2.5.9 的原始 Git 对象，未放宽任何旧限制。运行时备份也补齐了引擎元数据及完整二进制，便于后续升级失败时回滚。

## 包含最新插件修复

- Kilo 与匿名免费模型统一纳入免费池、标签数量和五格状态。
- 水位排除已限流、不可用、地区受限及隐藏的模型。26 个模型中 9 个限流时，17/26 显示为 65%。未探测仅作为候选，不冒充实测可用。
- 探测按模型使用独立上游会话，避免整轮共用配额造成批量限流误判。

## 安装与验证边界

自行安装的旧版用户可在插件升级页检查并升级。由包管理器管理的安装继续通过宿主更新可信 tarball，不绕过托管策略。手工安装请使用本次完整插件包，保留原有用户数据目录，不要只替换入口文件。

发布前需通过完整贡献者检查、生产签名及旧版升级回归，具体证据见 PR 与发布校验记录。已验证的旧版场景包括下载、安装、模块加载、用户数据保留、激活失败回滚、坏分片拒绝和 Windows 引擎启动。测试仅访问本地服务，不代表所有网络环境或真实模型上游均已验证。

## 回退

升级激活失败时自动恢复旧包；恢复遇到文件系统错误时保留已验证备份和错误证据，不报告成功。手工回退使用上一版可信插件包，并保留用户配置、账号和统计数据。

## 本次发布验证

- 完整贡献者测试 98/98、生产签名发布检查 5/5，四项 GitHub CI 均通过。
- 原版 1.3.1、2.5.9 升级回归通过；原版 2.5.9 已从公开固定提交地址完成升级，默认升级源也确认提供 2.7.2。原版 1.3.1 已通过自身默认公开升级源下载、安装并加载 2.7.2；79 项运行时文件均匹配生产清单，用户数据保留。
- 正式 tarball 从固定提交的 LF 字节构建，解包后的全部 79 项运行时文件逐字节匹配生产签名清单，入口模块加载通过。
- 本次仅插件发布，**不提供新的桌面安装包**；桌面端仍为原有版本。
- 未执行真实模型上游调用；不同网络环境仍可能影响下载。

## 下载与校验

| `SHA256SUMS` | 插件包与来源记录的 SHA-256 |

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
This release improves how the XeMFG backend uses the game's HUD textures, adds an optional frame rate limit to the display refresh, and fixes a flickering panel. The DLSS-G backend's startup discovery does less work.

## XeMFG backend

- **More games can use UI Composition.** Intel's frame generation requires the game's HUD-less color and UI textures in the display's exact format. Some games use another type of the same format: Cyberpunk 2077 provides its HUD-less color as `R8G8B8A8_TYPELESS`, and Death Stranding 2 its UI as `R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB` over an `R8G8B8A8_UNORM` output. These were rejected every frame, so **UI Composition** could not be used there. They are now copied into the display format and used.
- **HDR games using scRGB.** XeMFG already converts the game's FP16 scRGB image to HDR10 for Intel's frame generation. The game's FP16 HUD-less color now goes through the same conversion, so UI Composition can also be used in those games.
- **The panel shows the game's HUD inputs.** **Image quality → Game HUD inputs** lists HUD-less color and UI separately: received, received (converted), filtered or not provided. When the game provides HUD-less color and UI Composition is off, the panel suggests turning it on if HUD elements show artifacts. UI Composition stays off by default: with it, the HUD is drawn at the game's real frame rate instead of being interpolated.
- **New option: Limit to display refresh.** In **General → Smoothness and display**, off by default and available with the XeLL latency output. With a high game frame rate, the game's frames times the multiplier can be more than the display shows, so some generated frames are never displayed and motion can look uneven. The option limits the game's frame rate so that frames are presented 3% under the display refresh. The game's own frame limit still applies when it is lower. The panel warns when the frame rate is above the refresh; the option is never turned on automatically.
- **Panel flicker fixed.**

name: AppFlowy
body:
### 🚀 v0.14.11

#### New Features

- **Relative-date comparisons** — Added Today, Yesterday, and Tomorrow to date comparisons such as before, after, on or before, and on or after, so filters followed the calendar without selecting a new date each day.
- **YouTube captions** — Added direct import of available timestamped captions into AI transcript blocks without downloading audio or using transcription minutes. Retained audio transcription and file upload as alternatives when captions were unavailable.
- **Missing row pages** — Added a "Create empty page" action when a supporting server reported an unavailable row document, with a warning and explicit confirmation. Kept readable and locally cached content ahead of recreation.

#### Improvements

- **Gallery views** — Added grouped card layouts, configurable previews and card sizes, image fitting, and cover repositioning.
- **Feed views** — Refreshed card previews, quick actions, reactions, and comment discussions, with a full-page action for longer content.
- **Plans and connections** — Routed hosted upgrade prompts through the Plan settings, kept Cloud billing unavailable in local and self-hosted sessions, and added clearer connection-loading errors with retry actions.

#### Bug Fixes

- Fixed linking databases with incomplete sync data, refreshing embedded database tabs after sync, and loading repaired rows after an explicit retry.
- Made formula properties easier to find in filter and sort pickers, paused incompatible filters when formula result types changed, and corrected rollups that read other rollups.
- Preserved center peek when navigating between rows and prevented canceled row-page opens from leaving later opens stuck.
- Corrected page-reference states for trashed, missing, and temporarily unavailable pages, and stopped slow permission lookups from holding up the Share menu's people list.
- Kept reconnect feedback visible until the connection was confirmed, with another retry available

name: arcane
body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes manual job and updater behavior, improves Compose and workspace handling, and resolves a Rustic container certificate issue.

### Jobs and updates
- Require jobs to be enabled in saved settings before allowing manual runs (#4550, @grootbro).
- Allow manual updater runs to proceed even when updates are opted out (#4564, @kmendell).
- Resolve orphaned job run activities on startup (#4572, @kmendell).

### Compose and workspaces
- Respect the name set in a Compose file instead of the project name (#4561, @kmendell).
- Use mount-time environment and volume settings in the workspace cache listener (#4563, @kmendell).

### Backups
- Trust Arcane’s CA roots inside the Rustic container (#4554, @Mczubi).

name: EncoDeck
body:
### 新增

- 新增“实验室”页面：LE Audio（LC3）切换与 LHDC 设置从音效页移入，音效页只保留日常调音。
- 新增漫步者 28 款真无线耳机（Lolli、LolliPods、LolliClip、AtomBuds、Atom 等系列）：显示左右耳与充电盒电量，按型号使用经典蓝牙或 BLE 控制通道；降噪仅在耳机返回状态后显示。尚未真机验证。
- 新增 Razer Barracuda X 替换接收器 `1532:0550` 的无线连接、电量及充电线状态查询。尚未真机验证，详见 [Barracuda X 适配说明](https://github.com/TIANLI0/EncoDeck/blob/v1.9.0/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#razer-barracuda-x)。

### 改进

- LE Audio 切换在 Windows 11 24H2 及更新版本上改用系统成组配对：由 Windows 发现并配对另一只耳机，只接受同一副耳机的另一耳，双耳与传统蓝牙节点归入同一设备。配对进行中不会重复提交，单次配对 60 秒超时；系统不支持时沿用逐耳配对。Probe `le-audio --pair` 可加 `--legacy-pairing` 对照。
- 加强 LC3 控制通道保护：按设备识别左右耳；主耳 LE 配对缺失但另一耳仍有 LE 配对时，不再打开传统蓝牙控制通道。
- 首页和控制页的多设备连接列表会记住上次耳机报告的设备（不保存蓝牙地址）：打开应用时先显示上次记录，耳机回报后再替换为实时列表，在此之前不能连接、断开或移除设备。
- USB 游戏耳机查询失败时，日志会记录卡在哪一步，便于排查。
- 更新 LE Audio 左右同步说明：成组配对后实测仍经常左耳晚一帧（约 7.5 ms），详见 [LE Audio 说明](https://github.com/TIANLI0/EncoDeck/blob/v1.9.0/docs/LE_AUDIO.md)。

### 修复

- 修复 Windows 快速设置耳机面板因窗口边框计算不准导致的宽度、高度和位置偏差。

name: Apollo-Reborn
body:
### Features

- Add **iPhone Duo** support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel
  - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open
  - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it
- Add an optional **iPad Layout (Beta)** on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle)
  - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout
- Add **Restore Reading Session** to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1)
  - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session
- Add a **Setup Assistant** for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle)
  - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset
- Rework **Gallery View** with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen
- Open **Gallery View** for All Saved or a selected **Saved category**

name: Clash-for-Windows_Chinese
body:
### Clash for Windows 优化版
尝试借助 Agent 的力量对被混淆的代码逆向, 重构, 改进!

***

**`Clash.for.Windows.Setup_Opt-5.exe`, `Clash.for.Windows.Setup_Opt-5.arm64.exe`使用说明:**
* 按照一般流程双击打开安装程序进行安装/更新

**`Clash.for.Windows-Opt.5-win.7z`, `Clash.for.Windows-Opt.5-win32-arm64.7z`使用说明:**
* 解压后运行Clash for Windows.exe开始使用

**`Clash.for.Windows-Opt.5-linux-arm64.tar.gz`, `Clash.for.Windows-Opt.5-linux-x64.tar.gz`使用说明 (Ubuntu):**
* 将解压后的源码文件夹放入目标目录
* 运行目录里的 `install-desktop-entry.sh` (这可以在应用列表里创建正确的图标)
* 开始使用 / 运行目录里的 `cfw` 开始使用

**`Clash.for.Windows-Opt.5-linux-arm64.deb`, `Clash.for.Windows-Opt.5-linux-x64.deb`使用说明 (Ubuntu):**
* 运行 `sudo apt install [deb path]` 安装/更新.

**MacOS使用说明:**
* 确保安装了 nodeJs
* 克隆 [main](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/tree/main) 仓库
* 打开终端 cd 到该目录
* 运行 `npm ci` 加载所有构建所需资源
* 运行 `npm run package:dmg:mac-arm64` (以 M 系列芯片为例)
* 运行结束后应该就可以在应用列表中看到了 (或搜索到)

如果不会的话可以让 AI Agent 自动给你构建, 运行

> 由于 Apple 开发者的年费贵到~用爱发电~支付不了, 因此无法提供可公开分发的 MacOS 安装包, 故而只能手动构建安装

***

#### 更新内容：

* 完成将所有安全设置修改为一般推荐的做法 (启用了 [Sandbox](https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/sandbox) 以限制渲染进程).
* 修复了 User-Agent 损坏导致部分配置拉取服务器识别代理类别失败进而下载非 YAML 格式配置 #313 
* 将默认 User-Agent 改为了 `Mihomo.ClashforWindows/Optimize` 以让部分还以为 Clash for Windows 不支持新协议的订阅拉取服务器正确识别.
* 修复了已知重构导致的 UI 错误.
* 修复了 monaco 编辑器中的数字导航和输入按键优先级问题 #314 
* 语言控制改用 i18n 并支持热切换语言 (不再需要重启 UI 应用更改).
* 新增默认语言显示将跟随系统当前语言, 除非手动改了语言设置.
* 为一些文本补上缺失的翻译.
* 新增了一些安全限制 (可在设置中放权) 并修复部分安全设置损坏.
* 更新 Mihomo 到 v1.19.33
* 更新 Electron 到 v44.7.2
* 改进代理开关逻辑, 现在启用代理选项时会显示加载图标.
* 改进 TAP 的功能, 现在可以选择在不卸载 TAP 的情况下禁用, 对所有配置开放, 或仅允许 Mixin 设置能调用, ~再也不用怕有野生的配置直接来个 `:53` 端口监听强制开启代理了~.
* 改进配置文件右键编辑节点组的删除流程, 现在可以在删除组时选择相关规则是否跟随删除或给别的节点组继承.
* 修复了当连接页面里的地址条目过多时造成卡顿.

***

欢迎帮助我改进，或有其它什么问题请在[这里向我提问](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/issues/new/choose), 或是[查看以往的问题](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/issues)。
当然也更欢迎直接发起 [Pull request](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**OmO Native stops waiting on a stalled turn-end subscriber after two seconds.** Memory recovery remains retryable without treating the cancelled wait as a failed reflection run, and stall diagnostics identify the component and hook instead of only `omo.js`. Thanks to @floweredao for the report. ([#11254](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11254), Part of [#11249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11249)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Warm memory prompts avoid repeated git processes for HEAD and agreements.** Committed agreement reads are cached by repository and full revision, and cache misses inspect only the ledger path. Standard file-backed HEADs resolve from stat-validated Git files, including packed refs and linked worktrees, with git fallback for unusual layouts. ([#11216](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11216), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Unchanged memory notices no longer yield a warm prompt to cold recall.** Soul and agreement notices read their small atomic watermarks directly and skip lock acquisition only when valid state confirms nothing needs announcing or updating. Missing, malformed, or unreadable state is rechecked under the identity lock. Writers publish through unique, exclusively created temporary files, flush them before rename, and sync the directory where supported. ([#11215](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11215), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Memory notices survive a directory-sync failure after publication.** Soul and agreement watermarks still flush before atomic rename and attempt directory sync, but a sync error after publication is logged without discarding that turn'

name: shairport-sync
body:
## Version 5.6.2
This update contains a security-related bug fix and an enhancement for playing long sessions, and is recommended for all users.
Please refer to the  [release notes for Version 5.6.1](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/releases/tag/5.6.1) and [5.6](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/releases/tag/5.6) for full updating information.

### Security-Related Bug Fix
* Malformed DACP TLV (Tag-Length-Value) tokens could generate out-of-bounds (OOB) reads in Shairport Sync.
  The bug fix was to improve checking of DACP TLV payloads. Thanks to [memoriaru](https://github.com/memoriaru) for their [report](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/security/advisories/GHSA-vfxr-hxq9-9h35).

### Enhancement
* This enhancement changes how frames of audio are referenced, so that long sessions (greater than about 12.5 hours) do not go silent due to signed 32-bit integer sign overflow.
  
  Background: AirPlay associates a 32-bit _RTP timestamp_, a timing reference number, with every audio frame.
  After playing 2^31 - 1 frames of buffered audio -- about 12.5 hours at 48,000 frames per second --
  the total number of frames played exceeds 2^31 -1 and goes negative due to sign overflow. Timing calculations fail,
  causing frames to be dropped and the player to go silent.

  The enhancement develops 64-bit timestamps from RTP timestamps of the frames as they are processed in preparation for playing. Many thanks to [Martin Man](https://github.com/mman) for their patient troubleshooting, [PR](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/pull/2321) and initial [report](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/issues/2312).

Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. Remove more app leftovers with verified ownership: Uninstall now finds additional updater, crash-report, browser integration and sandbox data, while keeping files shared by other installed apps. 2. Keep game data under your control: `--with-data` leaves game libraries unselected so removing an app does not automatically select its games and saves. 3. More realistic cleanup estimates: Shared APFS blocks, sparse files and hardlinks no longer inflate the estimated space that cleanup can reclaim. 4. Protect active caches and project dependencies: Cleanup rechecks whether apps and projects are in use, and keeps dependency folders when it cannot confirm they can be restored. 5. Slimming respects more app signatures: `mo slim` skips files protected by an enclosing signature and apps explicitly rejected by Gatekeeper, and marks running apps before selection. 6. Keep unknown battery health unknown: Missing capacity readings no longer produce a Healthy label from a low cycle count, while known battery warnings remain visible. ### 更新日志 1. 卸载能找到更多明确属于应用的残留：补充更新器、崩溃报告、浏览器扩展连接和沙盒数据的识别，同时保留其他已安装应用仍在使用的内容。 2. 游戏数据由你决定：`--with-data` 不再默认选中游戏库，卸载应用时不会顺带选中其中的游戏和存档。 3. 清理空间估算更准确：减少 APFS 共享数据块、稀疏文件和硬链接造成的重复估算，让预计可清理空间更接近实际。 4. 保留正在使用的缓存和项目依赖：清理前再次检查应用与项目是否正在运行，无法确认依赖可以恢复时保留原目录。 5. 应用瘦身更稳妥：`mo slim` 跳过受外层签名保护的文件和被 Gatekeeper 明确拒绝的应用，并在选择前标出正在运行的应用。 6. 电池数据缺失时不再误报健康：无法读取容量时，不再仅凭较低的循环次数显示健康，已知的电池警告仍会保留。 ### Mole Mac App If you would rather work in a window than a terminal, [Mole Mac App](https://mole.fit/) covers cleaning, app removal, maintenance, disk analysis and live status, shows everything before it deletes, and adds tools in the menu bar. name: Magisk
body:
This release brings official support for Googlebooks (Aluminium OS), including automatic firmware download suggestions and the ability to patch recovery GPT images directly onto a connected USB drive. Bringing Magisk to Googlebooks also meant supporting Android's Headless System User Mode (HSUM), where user `0` operates strictly as a non-interactive background system user while human users run in secondary user profiles. Adapting Magisk to HSUM created several architectural challenges, as many longstanding features and internal mechanisms were built around the assumption that user `0` is always the primary interactive user.

To address this, the way superuser access is granted to apps has been redesigned, and the traditional interactive root request prompt has been removed. The existing reactive `su` request flow, which relies on intercepting a root call in the background daemon and launching a blocking UI prompt in the right user session, is fundamentally incompatible with HSUM, especially when handling non-app UIDs like `adb shell` that are not tied to a foreground user. Instead, superuser access is now explicitly granted to applications ahead of time directly from the Superuser tab in the Magisk app.

Finally, the app hiding (package repackaging) feature has also been removed. Like interactive `su` prompts, the repackaging and stub management mechanisms are fundamentally incompatible with HSUM. More importantly, truly hiding an installed package from detection is nearly technically impossible on Android. Since interactive root prompts no longer require the Magisk app to remain installed at runtime and Magisk no longer automatically reinstalls the app if it is missing, the most effective way to hide the Magisk app is to simply uninstall it after configuring your superuser policies and modules.

## Changelog

- [General] Support Headless System User Mode (HSUM) devices
- [General] Drop support for Android 6.0; Android 7.0 is now the minimum supported versi

This release bundles Aria2 Next 3.0.9 for all platforms. Downloads finish without a slow tail, a retried download no longer corrupts its file, and a slow IPv6 route no longer holds a download back. ## What's Changed

### Privacy & Site Controls
- **Global Privacy Control** (d525614e, 0702e9f8)
  An opt-in setting sends the Global Privacy Control signal to websites. It syncs through iCloud and is included in backup exports.
- **Blocked Request Count** (64a48ab3, 3c06ff25)
  Advanced settings can show a blocked-request count on Safari's toolbar icon. It counts supported requests handled by the scripts extension, not everything Safari's content blockers block, and is off by default.
- **Site Patterns** (24968377, 984f12c6, #1032)
  Filter-list and cosmetic-filtering site fields accept patterns such as amazon.*.
- **Cosmetic Filtering by Site** (b3cffdf4, fab01465, 3a09d425, #1031, #1035)
  Switch between selected sites and excluded sites without losing either list. Cosmetic rules written for amazon.* are retained when filtering is limited to amazon.it.

### Sync & Storage
- **Safer iCloud Sync** (276fecf5, 26b73073, 38cd5ea8)
  Stale devices no longer overwrite newer iCloud changes. Devices without a saved sync baseline take the cloud copy first.
- **Element Zapper Sync** (a11ce8cb)
  Rules added on two devices for the same site are preserved together.
- **Smaller Device Backups** (3cf26e15)
  Regenerable filter caches and compiled rules are excluded from device backups. Custom sources and settings are retained.
- **Dark Reader Backups** (cfa28004)
  Backup export includes Dark Reader's system-appearance setting.
- **Regional Filter Order** (5ca96e1a, 8cf1bd06, 413ceec7)
  Reorder regional filters and sync their display order across devices without the list jumping during a drag.

### Blocking & Updates
- **Popup Blocking** (7db6133a, 82737b26)
  AdGuard Popup Blocker runs in the page again so it can intercept popups.
- **Default Host List** (493f1123)
  The built-in ad and tracking hosts have their own filter list and can update independently.

  Fresh userscript pushes are detected. Older mirror copies

## What's in v0.10.2


Codewhale v0.10.2 adds an animated pet view (`/pet on`), a live Terminal work
dock, per-chat composer colors (`/color`) and a one-time note on the first
start after an update that says what changed. It closes three session
data-loss paths and a `codewhale web` session leak; adds the default Runtime
daemon socket locations to the sandbox deny-list; holds a `curl` or `wget` that uploads a
credential; refuses shell commands containing invisible Unicode; keeps the
Linux sandbox working when a hidden credential directory is a symlink; and
reduces idle TUI redraw work. `/undo` takes back a whole
request, including long and multiline prompts. `exec --auto` explains its
Full Access default, honors an explicitly stricter sandbox, and saves
tool-enabled runs and their failure receipts. Local runtimes appear during
onboarding, `/diff` works outside a Git repository, DeepSeek's Responses route
no longer rejects replayed tool history, and contributor fixes improve token
accounting, relay model lists, localized replies and Windows launcher
guidance. Delegated work continues without model-invented turn or time caps,
and independent workflow steps can continue after another child fails.

body:
# CC Switch v4.0.20

本版本新增对 Oh My Pi 的支持，它是 CC Switch 管理的第 13 个应用：多个供应商可以同时写进它的 `models.yml`，MCP、Skills、提示词同步给 Oh My Pi，会话可以浏览和恢复，「应用」页可以安装、升级、卸载 Oh My Pi。「应用」页分成「已安装」「未安装」两组，已安装的应用可以拖动排序，侧栏跟着这个顺序。Kimi 官方账号的卡片现在可以编辑模型、从 Kimi Code 里移除；托管的 ChatGPT 账号可以用浏览器登录。另外修复了 DeepSeek 余额用完后显示成「套餐已过期」、Kimi Code 子代理的用量没有统计、Skills 更新一直报 HTTP 429、Pi 的 API Key 写成环境变量引用时额度查询 401、Claude Code 会话标题显示成 `<local-command-stdout>`、Linux 上开启应用级窗口按钮后页头拖不动等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.20-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.20-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Oh My Pi

Oh My Pi（命令是 `omp`）现在是一个独立的应用，有自己的供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词和会话（[#6747](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6747)、[#8308](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8308)）。配置在 `~/.omp/agent`，用了命名 profile 时在 `~/.omp/profiles/<名称>/agent`；也可以在设置里改成别的目录。

- **供应商可以同时启用。** 和 Pi 一样，卡片上是「启用」「移除」，多个供应商同时写进 `models.yml`，在 Oh My Pi 里选用。只改 CC Switch 写的那一条，文件里其他内容原样保留；用了 YAML 锚点、标签这类写法的条目不会被重写，会提示你手动修改。
- **写入前按 Oh My Pi 的规则检查。** Oh My Pi 只要有一条供应商不合规，就会停用所有自定义供应商，所以填了它不接受的值，保存时会直接提示，不会写进去。只有旧版的 `models.json`、还没有 `models.yml` 时，会提示你先运行一次 `omp`，让它自己迁移，不会新建文件挤掉你原来的供应商。
- **添加供应商。** 表单和 Pi 共用，预设也来自 Pi 的目录；「获取模型列表」后在弹窗里勾选模型。「模型自动发现」（让 Oh My Pi 自己去接口查有哪些模型）和请求头、兼容选项一起放在「高级选项」里。API Key 可以写环境变量名，查询额度时 CC Switch 会按 Oh My Pi 的规则取出实际的值。
- **MCP、Skills、提示词。** MCP 写进 `mcp.json`，Skills 装进 Oh My Pi 自己的技能目录，提示词写进 `AGENTS.md`。Oh My Pi 还会从其他工具的目录里找 MCP 和技能，实际加载的可能比 CC Switch 里列出的多，MCP 和 Skills 页 Oh My Pi 一列的说明里有解释。
- **会话。** 可以浏览和恢复 Oh My Pi 的会话，预览里能显示项目里的图片。
- **「应用」页管理 Oh My Pi。** 用官方安装脚本安装（装了 Bun 就用 Bun，没装就下载官方的二进制），升级运行 `omp update`（用 Homebrew 装的仍然走 Homebrew），可以卸载。
- Oh My Pi 不经过本地路由，也暂不统计用量。

### 托管 ChatGPT 账号可以用浏览器登录

在授权中心或 Codex 的供应商表单里添加托管 ChatGPT 账号时，可以在「登录方式」里选「浏览器登录」（[#8288](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8288)、[#82

name: Auto_Bangumi
body:
# [4.0]

## 4.0.0 — 插件化重构

4.0 是插件化重构的大版本：下载、通知、解析、搜索、重命名与整理都通过同一套扩展点实现，内置功能与第三方插件走相同的接口。下载器可以有多个实例；重命名、硬链接、种子过滤与媒体库刷新由内置插件提供；新增插件市场。

Docker 镜像：`ghcr.io/estrellaxd/auto_bangumi:4.0.0`（Docker Hub：`estrellaxd/auto_bangumi:4.0.0`）。`latest` 现在指向 4.0。

### 升级前必读

- **只支持从 3.3.x 升级。** 检测到更早版本的数据时拒绝启动，并提示先升级到最新的 3.3.x 启动一次。
- **使用 `latest` 标签的 3.3 用户，下一次拉取镜像就会升级到 4.0。** 拉取前请备份 `config` 与 `data` 目录。暂时不升级，就把标签固定为 `3.3.7`。
- **第一次启动自动迁移。** 原配置备份为 `config.json.v3.bak`；数据库升级到 schema v28，3.3 的数据库备份为 `data/data.db.v3.bak`。
- **应用内更新不能从 3.3 升级到 4.0**，请更换镜像标签。3.3.7 起，3.3 的应用内更新只提供 3.x 版本。
- 升级步骤、迁移细节与回滚方法见 [从 3.3 升级到 4.0](https://www.autobangumi.org/deploy/upgrade-4.0)。

### 破坏性变更

- **配置结构。** 下载器改为 `plugins.instances` 中的实例，`plugins.slots.downloader` 指向默认实例；重命名方式与版本冲突策略移到 `plugins.slots.rename_strategy` / `plugins.slots.conflict_policy`。第一次启动时自动迁移。`AB_DOWNLOADER_*`、`AB_DOWNLOAD_PATH`、`AB_METHOD`、`AB_REVISION_CONFLICT_POLICY` 环境变量照常生效。
- **通知渠道旧字段。** Bark 改用 `device_key`（不再读取 `token`），WeCom 改用 `webhook_url`（不再读取 `chat_id`）。自动迁移。
- **移除的 API 与配置。** 3.2 兼容的 GET 控制端点（`/api/v1/restart`、`/start`、`/stop`、`/shutdown`）与 `GET /api/v1/auth/refresh_token` 已移除，请改用 POST。移除 `experimental_openai` 配置节、通知的单渠道旧字段与 `normal` 重命名方式（自动改为行为相同的 `none`）。
- **MCP** 只提供 Streamable HTTP，端点为 `/mcp`；旧的 `/mcp/sse` 已删除，请更新 MCP 客户端的地址。
- **API。** 带 JSON 请求体的调用必须发送 `Content-Type: application/json`，否则返回 422；未知的 `/api/…` 路径返回 404。
- **运行环境与插件 SDK。** Docker 镜像使用 Python 3.14，HTTP 客户端换成 httpx2。插件 SDK `ab_sdk` 0.6.0 的 `build_http_client` 返回 `httpx2.AsyncClient`。

### 新功能

- **插件系统。** 插件可以提供下载器、通知渠道、LLM 解析、搜索站点、元数据源、定时任务、REST 路由、MCP 工具与 WebUI 界面，也可以在 RSS 下载流程中过滤种子、修正解析结果、修改保存路径与请求头。钩子有超时，连续失败 5 次的插件被自动停用。
- **插件市场。** 新增「插件市场」页面：按分类与状态筛选，安装前确认来源、权限与前端。安装时校验 sha256 与 ed25519 签名。首批上架：Webhook、ntfy、Slack、Synology Chat 与 Apprise 通知，运行外部命令，STRM 文件，NFO 文件，模板重命名，自定义 RSS 站点，手动选种。第三方插件经 PR 上架。
- **多下载器。** 可以添加多个 qBittorrent、aria2 或插件提供的下载器实例。规则与订阅可以选择下载器；每个种子记录它所在的实例，重命名与删除都在该实例上进行。
- **重命名与整理。** `pn` / `advance` 由内置插件提供，输出与 3.3 逐字一

body:
# v3.1.0 — release notes / 更新说明

These notes describe the v3.1.0 source changes. The published package and its provenance must be verified separately through the protected release workflow, GitHub Releases and npm.

本文描述 v3.1.0 源码改动。实际已发布的包体及来源证明需通过受保护流程、GitHub Releases 和 npm 另行核实。

## Simpler setup / 更容易使用

- **#754**: The Vision Router General page no longer treats merely choosing a model as proof that images can reach it. When DSH declares a model text-only, a concise bilingual explanation points to DSH Settings → Models → Image input, with a Recheck action and optional collapsed legacy Host help. The plugin never silently changes Host model metadata, and enabling a flag does not grant multimodal capabilities to a text-only model.
- **#754**：不再把“选中了模型”误报成“肯定能看图”。DSH 明确声明纯文本时，默认界面用简短中文/英文提示用户在 DSH「设置 → 模型」开启图片输入，并提供「重新检测」；旧版 YAML 字段折叠在可选帮助中。插件不会擅自修改 Host 模型配置，也不会把纯文本模型变为多模态模型。
- **#756**: Cloud-image privacy guidance now tells the user exactly how to stop **Vision Router image uploads**: on the DSH machine, enable Local-only vision in Vision Router → General and **Save**. A browser-local “Do not remind again” preference minimizes repeated explanation, while retaining a short egress status and a “How to stop uploads” control. Dismissing the notice **does not consent to uploads or change settings**. Unsaved changes never claim that the local-only policy has taken effect. A cloud chat model can still receive **derived vision-result text**; fully local use also requires selecting a local chat model.
- **#756**：清楚告诉用户在运行 DSH 的电脑上打开 Vision Router「常规」，开启「仅本地视觉」并**保存**，即可阻止**本插件向云端视觉服务上传图片**。可勾选「不再提醒」，该浏览器仍保留一行提醒和「查看如何关闭出网」入口；收起提醒**不等于授权上传，也不会修改配置**。未保存的草稿不会误报为已生效。如果聊天模型在云端，**识图结果文字仍可能出网**；完全本地使用还需在聊天页选择本地聊天模型。

# 🩹 Komi Store 1.9.4

A fix-up release for 1.9.3. If app pages froze in Classic, this update is for you.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Classic app pages no longer freeze** on apps you have installed. You no longer need to switch to Manga to get around it
- **No more crash on big repositories**: opening a repository with a very long release list, like sing-box, no longer crashes the app after a restart
- **READMEs**: HTML tables, such as team and contributor grids, render as text and images instead of code
- **Releases**: when our server returns an empty release list, Komi Store checks GitHub before showing "No releases"
- **Updates**: the Update button shows right after an update check and opens on the new release
- **Backup import**: importing a backup on another phone skips apps that aren't installed there, and the summary lists them, instead of showing them as installed
- **Auto-translate** also covers the release notes after you switch channel or app, or retry
- **Download mirror**: Direct GitHub is always in the list
- **Signature check**: the check before an update stays on after an app is updated outside Komi Store

## ✨ Also New
- **Diagnostics (Android)**: Komi Store now keeps a log and saves a report when it crashes, both only on your device. Tweaks → Developer & diagnostics shares them as one file, with tokens removed, when you want to report a problem. Nothing leaves your phone unless you share it

## 🗓️ What's next
The next stable release is still planned for early 2027.

2. 双击对应的 `MAW` 可执行文件，打开启动器

4. 完成后，启动字幕编辑器，进行字幕精修

详细文档参阅：[完整使用文档](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/user/WORKFLOW.md)
遇到问题可以参见：[常见问题](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/user/FAQ.md)

## [1.10.0-beta.2] - 2026-10-24

1.10 第二个预览版集中交付编辑器性能与交互修复：大幅缓解大工程切换字词时间码与纯文本编辑的卡顿，恢复字词码下的接缝拖动，修复空隙跳过僵持、波形按 B 误入列表编辑与撤销后预览不更新；同时带来工程音量与响度、MASS 斜体、单句放大出现、启动器最近工程、叠加字幕逐句缩放与实际画面表情包叠加等新能力。

### 🚀 全新特性

- **工程音量与响度** ： 编辑器播放器新增 📣 可移动窗口，可在试听时调整固定增益、测量 LUFS 并匹配参考响度；默认 −14 LUFS，支持预设和自定义目标，常规增益范围可按需扩大，监听音量显示百分比。同一工程增益应用于播放预览、整段烧录、去空隙烧录和带音轨绿幕视频，并随工程保存。匹配按真峰值余量限制增益，不添加压缩；监听音量只影响试听。

### ✨ 提升

- **MASS 弱化改用 `%%` 并新增斜体** ： ASS 特殊文本样式的弱化文本从 `//文字//` 改为 `%%文字%%`，`//文字//` 改为表示斜体（导出 ASS 斜体标签，预览同步渲染）；两者均为固定双符号，设置页各有独立开关，符号规则选「无」时保留全部原文。旧工程中已用 `//` 标记的弱化文本会按新语法显示为斜体，不做自动迁移。

- **单句放大出现动画** ： ASS 模式新增句级标记 `{{文字}}`，该句以「从大到小落定」的入场动画出现（默认 1.4 倍、250ms，可在样式库「放大出现」中调整起点倍率、入场时长与加速度），可与淡入淡出、原地震动、整句字号等按任意嵌套顺序组合，Canvas 预览与 ASS 导出帧一致。样式库同时把「淡入淡出」与「放大出现」的参数编辑和全局开关解耦：关闭开关后单句标记仍复用这些时长/倍率参数，开关只控制「每一句自动应用」。

- **启动器最近工程** ： 「编辑器」卡片直接展示本机

name: gpu-unlock-ada
body:
GPU Unlock 1.1.1 publishes a reproducible SM89 tensor issue-rate probe and matched stock/unlocked TF32 and unsigned INT4 results on one RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (`10de:2705`, NVIDIA `580.178.04`, 240 W cap). The Ada unlock transaction is unchanged from 1.1.0; the module and DKMS version metadata advance to 1.1.1.

| Register-resident mode | Stock | Unlocked |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| FP16 inputs, FP32 accumulate (control) | 94.96 TF/s | 188.97 TF/s |
| TF32 inputs, FP32 accumulate | 47.49 TF/s | 94.51 TF/s |
| Unsigned INT4 inputs, INT32 accumulate | 754.81 TOP/s | 754.68 TOP/s |

The same cubin, card, driver, 240 W cap, and launch settings were used in both boots. Each mode checked 270,336 output cells with zero mismatches per state. **TF32 instruction issue rate gained 1.99×; unsigned INT4 did not improve.** These all-one, register-resident loops do not establish an application GEMM or inference speedup. INT8 and one previously tested FP8 GEMM were also unchanged.

Read the [canary report](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/blob/v1.1.1/docs/ada-2705-report.md), [sanitized numeric output and hashes](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/tree/v1.1.1/docs/evidence/ada2705), and [GPL benchmark source and reproduction steps](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/blob/v1.1.1/diagnostics/bench/README.md). Installation and boot rollback are in the [Quick Start](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/blob/v1.1.1/QUICKSTART.md).

The exact source-only archive ran 22 Linux host tests with 8 optional-input skips, and its kernel module compiled against the tested host's `5.15.0-177-generic` headers as version 1.1.1. The owner miner stayed running through this CPU-only validation. The downloadable archive contains no NVIDIA firmware binary; pinned NVIDIA inputs are generated locally under NVIDIA's separate license.
