name: Magpie
body:
# Magpie Experimental v0.6.11

本版新增可调整大小的性能分析浮窗和捕获／输出图表，完善 XeSS FG 帧间隔显示，加入 DLSS 模型预设与 DLSSNR 抗闪烁响应时间，并改进暂停截图和文件命名。

## 功能更新

### 性能分析浮窗

- 默认显示各效果器耗时及总耗时，展开“图表”可查看最近 10 秒的变化。
- 帧率、帧间隔分别显示**捕获／输出**两条曲线；效果器耗时保留一张总耗时图。捕获统计有效新帧，输出包含补帧，不包含光标、界面刷新及旧画面重放。
- 帧间隔提供均值和峰值，修复 **XeSS FG 2×／3×／4× 输出帧间隔无法显示**的问题。无法获取的数据显示为缺测；计时覆盖不完整时显示“部分统计”。
- 拖动右下角可调整浮窗大小，尺寸和位置会被记住。图表默认折叠，内容支持纵向滚动；没有内容时隐藏“开发者选项”。

### 暂停截图与文件命名

- 修复暂停画面时，包含原始输入的截图不能及时保存的问题。继续支持**输入＋输出、仅输出、仅输入**，成对截图对应同一画面。
- 截图统一使用 **`Magpie_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss_SSS_input.png`** 和 **`Magpie_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss_SSS_output.png`**，同组共用时间戳，重名时自动追加序号。右键效果／通道导出同样使用时间戳，并保留效果、Pass、纹理用途后缀及 PNG／DDS 格式。

### DLSS SR 模型预设

在**效果组页面 → 对应效果器行右侧的参数按钮**中选择，修改后重新开始缩放生效。

- 新增**自动、A–F（CNN）、J／K（Transformer 1代）、L／M（Transformer 2代）**。
- 默认 **K**；旧配置未设置时也使用 K，已有选择保留。
- 修复所选预设在部分质量模式下未生效的问题。

### DLSS FG 运行库与预设

- 更新 `dlssg_for_sm86` 至 **0.4.0**，配套 `nvngx_dlssg.dll` 至 **310.9.16.0**。
- 在倍率和光流选项之间新增模型预设：**自动（默认）、A（标准）、B（UI 重建 - 不生效）、C（性能模式）**。B 的 UI 重建功能当前不生效；修改预设后重新开始缩放。

### DLSSNR 抗闪烁响应时间

- 新增**抗闪烁响应时间**：范围 **5–200 ms**，步进 **5 ms**，默认 **80 ms**。数值越大越稳定、跟随变化越慢；数值越小响应越快。
- 调整后随下一帧画面生效，无需重新开始缩放。关闭抗闪烁时隐藏控件并保留设置值。

### DLSSNR 默认运行库

- 主包默认携带 **310.9.16 社区兼容版** `nvngx_dlssnr.dll`，供 RTX 20／30／40 系列使用。
- RTX 50 系列可从可选附件中使用 **NVIDIA 原版 310.9.16**。可选包保留原版和社区兼容版两个选项。

### RTSS 兼容提示

使用 RTSS 时，如果切换 DLSS／XeSS 效果链出现崩溃，可先退出 RTSS 后重试。相关说明见包内 `XESSFG.md`。

## 应该下载哪个文件？

首次安装或从任意旧版本、本地 Beta 升级，统一下载完整主包 **`Magpie-Experimental-x64.zip`**。

将 ZIP 完整解压到新目录，运行其中的 `Magpie.exe`。升级前先备份设置并从托盘完全退出旧版，保留旧程序和配置备份供回退。

### 可选附件

| 附件                     | 用途                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

手动截图现在可以在设置中选择 JPEG 或无损 PNG。JPEG 保留原有的 70/85/92/100 质量档，切到 PNG 后隐藏无意义的质量选项。原有配置继续默认 JPEG，格式选择会持久保存并同步到实际编码、文件扩展名和 Android 相册导出的 MIME 类型。截图开始时固定所选格式，避免异步过程中改设置导致文件内容与扩展名不一致。关联：[#713](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/713)

**弹幕轨道独立调轴** ([#997](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/997))

每条弹幕轨道现在可以单独设置小数秒偏移并随时重置，正数提前、负数延后，与原整体偏移叠加生效。合并显示、导出和新发送的弹幕统一使用调整后的时间，原始弹幕保持不变，反复编辑不会累积。两套主题都提供轨道调轴入口，弹窗跨切集时不会改写新轨道。偏移仅对当前播放中的轨道有效，界面已说明这一生命周期。关联：[#711](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/711)

**WebDAV / SMB 支持同时配置内网与公网地址** ([#1018](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1018))

连接配置现在可以同时填写内网和公网地址。应用启动阶段在后台检测媒体库可用性，自动切换到合适线路（内网优先）。配置已接入备份和同步系统，升级后原地址会自动无感迁移到新字段。顺带把内嵌的预设正则屏蔽插件升级到与商店版本一致。

**Linux 支持构建 Flatpak 安装包** ([#1026](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1026))

新增符合 Flathub 规范的 Flatpak 构建清单、桌面文件、AppStream 元数据与多尺寸图标，支持 x86_64 与 aarch64 双架构，并把打包接入 Linux 构建发布流水线。清单已适配本版新增的 Erika 原生运行库、游戏手柄与 mimalloc 动态库依赖。

---

## 体验改进

**综合性能优化** ([#1004](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/1004))

对 UI 动画、启动流程、后台服务和操作细节做了一轮系统性优化。界面侧收窄了状态订阅与通知范围，日志列表、弹层标题、GIF 预览等控件改为局部刷新；启动阶段延后非首帧必需的服务，去掉默认启动的媒体权限请求与固定等待，SMB 改为按需初始化。列表与图片侧加入在途请求共享、解码尺寸限制与及时释放，Jellyfin/Emby 大列表改为分批请求和逐页解析，弹幕缓存、字幕索引和番剧详情都改为按需加载并做有界缓存。隐藏标签页与后台页面会停止轮播、下载和媒体库轮询，播放缩略图的解码、缩放与编码移到后台 isolate。

**播放器控制栏提示气泡不再与弹层重叠** ([#988](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/988))

画面比例、播放器菜单和播放列表按钮的悬浮提示气泡会浮在按钮上方 20px，弹层也从按钮上方展开，于是出现两个气泡叠在一起（Windows 桌面最明显），气泡还会挡住下面菜单项的点击。现在任一播放器弹层打开时提示气泡自动隐藏，并整体忽略鼠标事件，不再拦截输入。同时把画面比例按钮的提示精简为功能名，避免长文案在 12px 下折行。

个人中心 → Bangumi 的按钮恢复为在外部浏览器打开官方访问令牌页面，按钮文案改为「前往 Bangumi 创建访问令牌」。打开失败时（例如 Web 端）回退到说明弹窗并展示纯文本链接。关联：[#1006](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/1006)

name: KokoroMemo
body:
Termux 修复版：修复 pydantic v1 启动失败、一键安装旧版本、后台存活、端口配置和冷启动加载问题；同时包含向量后端、记忆审核与可维护性改进。

# KokoroMemo 0.14.1

### 新增

- 增加可配置向量后端 `storage.vector_store = auto | lancedb | sqlite`：`auto` 优先 LanceDB 并在导入或初始化失败时自动回退 SQLite，`lancedb` 在不可用时明确报错，`sqlite` 完全使用 SQLite + numpy，适用于不支持 AVX2 的老 CPU、容器和 Termux 环境；GUI 服务配置新增“向量存储后端”选项，切换后端后需要重建向量索引（#6）。
- 长期记忆判断新增 `source` / `evidence` 输出契约和 `memory.judge.reject_unverified` 开关（默认开启）：助手来源、缺少用户原文证据或证据无法在用户发言中逐字匹配的候选会被丢弃；状态板填表提示词同步禁止把助手单方面编造或推测的物件、事实和承诺写入状态，除非用户后续明确确认（#7）。
- 新增 `/admin/airp-recall-explanation` 契约，汇总最近会话 retrieval trace、最终注入记忆、隔离排除原因和潜在串记风险；仪表盘增加官方召回解释入口，展示当前角色、本轮选中记忆、角色/会话/记忆库隔离排除和下一步入口。
- 新增 `/admin/airp-memory-audit` 契约，汇总当前角色已批准记忆、待审核候选、已拒绝候选和状态板 active 行；仪表盘增加记忆账本入口和状态快照，让用户直接看到角色记住了什么、哪些内容被拒绝以及当前剧情停在哪里。
- 新增 `GET /admin/vector-backend-status` 诊断接口，报告配置后端、实际生效后端、索引行数和带过滤检索自检；索引非空但过滤检索返回空时会标记 `degraded` 并提示重建或切换 SQLite 后端（#7）。
- 新增 `GET /admin/config-schema` 配置清单接口，返回字段路径、类型、默认值和废弃原因；`GET /admin/degradation-status` 汇总检索、抽取、状态填表和向量同步等降级通道的累计次数与最近错误，便于排查“设置不生效”和静默降级。

### 改进

- `balanced` 召回策略不再使用硬编码规模，改为读取 `memory.vector_top_k`、`memory.final_top_k` 和 `memory.max_injected_chars`，向量召回评分读取 `memory.scoring.*`；`/admin/retrieval-profiles` 同步返回实际生效值，修复设置页修改后检索与注入不生效的问题（#7）。
- LanceDB 元数据过滤返回 0 行时自动重试一次无过滤检索，并在 Python 侧重新校验 user、character、conversation、scope 和记忆库可见性，避免过滤兼容问题导致“记忆存了却用不上”；无过滤仍为空时输出明确 warning 并提示切换 `storage.vector_store=sqlite`，不绕过隔离（#7）。
- CI 与 Release 预检新增 `验证 AIRP 召回解释契约`、`验证 AIRP 记忆隔离门禁` 和 `验证 AIRP 记忆账本契约` 步骤，覆盖空状态、正常召回解释、跨角色误召回风险、跨会话和未挂载记忆库不会进入最终注入，以及角色记忆、待审核、已拒绝和状态板位置。
- 模型回复被 `max_tokens` 截断（`finish_reason=length/max_tokens`）时，不再触发状态板填表和记忆抽取，避免把不完整回答中的幻觉内容写入长期记忆或当前状态；流式与非流式代理都会记录该结束原因（#7）。
- 配置清理：`fallback_rule_based`、`extract_after_each_turn`、`hot_context.inject_always`、`auto_expire_resolved_items`、`detect_system_prompt_change` 这些未参与运行逻辑的开关已从 GUI、`/admin/config` 和示例配置中移除，并在配置清单中标记为废弃，减少“设置了但没效果”的误导。
- 向量存储统一为 `VectorStore` Protocol 和 `get_vector_store` 规范入口，`get_lancedb_store` 保留为兼容别名；管理路由统

name: jellyfin-mpv-shim
body:
This release updates the certificate bundles to distrust the [compromised eMudhra CA](https://scotthelme.co.uk/eight-bits-of-trust-emudhras-ca-keys-cracked-in-milliseconds/). Without it, anyone could intercept HTTPS requests to your Jellyfin server *until 2039*. The release was tested against `mitmproxy --emudhra` to confirm both mpv and python reject the certificate.

Security:
- Fix eMudhra TLS bypass via compromised CA.
  - For PyPI users, `jellyfin-mpv-shim` takes a hard dependency against `certifi>=2026.10.19`, to ensure you also get the fix.

Additional Changes:
- Add Special Features for movies and TV shows (#759)
- Fixed a second player window opening when restoring from minimized (#828)
- The app now exits cleanly if the player cannot be restarted.
- The Trailer button only appears when the server has a trailer.
- Add a More menu to detail pages with Refresh Metadata (#764)
- Delete from Disk moved into the More menu.
- Improve button UX and update Elegance theme (#839, #840)
- Fix invalid regex throwing, windows direct paths, credential file perms, handle nullable settings ([pokke#1](https://github.com/pokke/jellyfin-mpv-shim/pull/1))

When upgrading/installing on Linux via PyPI, use:

```
pip install --upgrade "jellyfin-mpv-shim[all]"
```
You can also [install on Linux via Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.github.iwalton3.jellyfin-mpv-shim).

About testing: The end-to-end test suite now has a faster light tier for use during development, and the release gate still runs the full suite on both mpv backends on Linux and Windows.

About Windows Downloads:
 - If your CPU is older than roughly 2013 or you get a `0xc0000142` error you need to use the LEGACY64 build.
 - You do not need administrator rights to install the software.
 - You can avoid warnings on files by unblocking the file in the properties dialog.
 - **You may need to disable Smart App Control if unblocking via Properties does not work.**

# DeskBox 1.5.9

DeskBox 1.5.9 is a feature update: Windows 11-native right-click menus, a calmer and more capable updater, a recovery offer after configuration wipes, Korean language support, a clear notice on fully elevated desktops, and a wide reliability pass over widgets, drag-drop, and memory.

Released on October 23, 2026.

- **A recovery offer after a configuration wipe.** When a launch detects missing settings plus a surviving snapshot that passes the hard gates, a one-time window offers restore-or-fresh; scheduled snapshots pause until the decision lands.

name: tiez-clipboard
body:
> **候选版（rc.1）**：这是 1.0.0 正式版前的候选版，可能还有问题，欢迎在测试群或 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jimuzhe/tiez-clipboard/issues) 反馈。测试版会通过「检查更新」收到之后的测试版和正式版。

**相比 beta.8**（上一个公开测试版）：这一版主要是问题修复，另有拖拽、键盘操作和设置上的几项改进。

**新增与改进**
- **拖到其他软件**：拖动记录改用系统自己的拖拽。图片、视频和文件拖出去是真实的文件（之前拖进资源管理器或聊天软件没有反应），文字类记录保留格式或链接。少数嵌在记录里、没有对应文件的旧图片仍按原来的方式拖动。
- **鼠标和方向键共用一个选中**：鼠标移到哪条，方向键就从哪条接着走，同一时间只高亮一条。用方向键时，停着不动的鼠标不会抢走选中，双栏右侧的详情也不会切到鼠标下的记录；移动鼠标后再交回鼠标。关闭「方向键选择」时，鼠标悬停和以前一样。
- 方向键选中记录后，按 Delete 删除（已固定的记录不会被删）；Tab / Shift+Tab 切换分类（窗口获得焦点时）；Shift+Enter 只复制不粘贴，窗口保持打开。
- 纯文本粘贴快捷键粘贴最新复制的一条，不再是置顶的那条；窗口打开并用方向键选中时，粘贴选中的那条。
- 带格式粘贴时一并带上复制时的图片，由目标软件自己选用：聊天软件得到图片，办公软件得到可编辑的表格。
- AI 助手：添加了带 Key 的模型后，没有 Key 的预设任务会自动改用它；DeepSeek 关闭「思考」后不再思考。
- 「打开方式」每种类型都可以改回「系统默认」。
- 历史记录很多时，搜索更快，搜索和删除时界面不再卡顿。
- **磨砂主题**：去掉了叠在系统磨砂材质上的那层灰色，看起来更干净；「面板透明度」现在从 0 开始，往上调会叠加白色（深色模式为黑色），最多约 40%。

**稳定性**
- 修复一个罕见的卡死：TieZ 停止记录、不再响应，只能重启。
- 修复复制某些内容时 TieZ 闪退的问题。
- 修复顺序粘贴结束时可能卡死的问题。
- 一条记录读不出来时，不再导致整个列表加载失败。

**剪贴板与粘贴**
- 从历史记录打开图片不再提示「内部错误」。数据文件夹换过位置后（比如升级时旧文件夹被改名、恢复了备份），列表里显示的图片可以正常打开；文件确实不在了，提示「文件已被移动或删除」。
- 从 Excel、Word 带格式粘贴时，表格和格式不再丢失。
- 清理规则设为「不记录」时真正不记录；规则里的「=>」和换行会原样保留。
- 复制规则里关闭某个应用的记录后，它的图片、文件和视频也不再记录。
- 编辑过的图片不会因为再次复制原图而被换回去。
- 「另存为」选到原文件时不再把文件清空。
- 把长内容拖到其他软件时带上全部内容。

**列表与标签**
- **点记录不再误触**：点记录上的备注会粘贴这一条，和点记录其他地方一样，不再打开备注编辑；编辑备注请用记录的备注按钮，或详情里的「编辑备注」。搜索框下方的标签点击后只筛选，不会再把下面的记录粘贴出去；记录也只有在同一条上按下并松开时才粘贴。
- 便签主题：搜索框下方的标签列表改为不透明，下面的记录文字不再透出来。
- 删除、固定、加备注或同步后，列表停在原来的位置，不再跳回顶部。
- 置顶记录上的快捷键提示与实际粘贴的一致；筛选状态下拖动置顶记录不会打乱被隐藏的那些。
- 删除标签只移除标签，不再删除带这个标签的记录。
- 标签管理：切换标签时清除已选，批量删除只作用于当前显示的记录；编辑很长的记录不再被截断；所有敏感标签都不能改名或删除；开启「隐藏隐私」时，这里也隐藏敏感内容。
- 标签改名为敏感标签（或改回普通标签）时，相关记录的加密状态随之更新。
- 菜单或弹窗打开时按 Esc 只关闭它，不会连窗口一起隐藏。

**设置**
- 「恢复默认设置」立即生效，不用重启。
- 录制快捷键时离开输入框就结束录制。
- 清空的快捷键、全部取消的隐私类型，重启后保持原样。
- 「记录排序」各选项的名称与实际排序一致。

**同步**
- WebDAV：删除和编辑在下次同步时就到达其他设备，编辑后不再出现新旧两条；某台设备在服务器上的数据读不出来，或某条内容、快照上传失败时，其余内容照常同步；恢复默认设置或重装后同步照常。
- 「同步内容」里关闭的类型不再下载，重新打开后补齐。
- 删除的表情收藏不会再被同步回来。
- 历史条数上限只清理本机，不再删掉其他设备上的记录。

**局域网互传**
- 断开的手机会从设备列

name: Collapse
body:
![UpdateIsAvailable-Campaign-Columbina](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7043018-4d49-48f2-adf1-3c846fd3c3e4)
# Stable 1.84.7 (Codename: Columbina)

# What's Changed? - 1.84.7
## **[Fix]** Property Assignment Race Condition on Game Update State, by @neon-nyan 
This bug caused some issues in some game update mechanisms (in this example: Zenless Zone Zero Update 3.3.0), where it was previously unable to recognize the update and caused the game to be left erroneously on the previous version. The bug caused certain values for the game version from the Sophon API to go missing due to a race condition and false assignments on the loader properties, causing a domino effect which resulted the game version being null and assigning a version from a deprecated ZIP API.

## **[Imp]** Memory Allocation Optimization on Sophon and SharpHPatchZ Submodules
Thanks to the [SharpHPatchZ (formerly SharpHDiffPatch)](https://github.com/CollapseLauncher/SharpHDiffPatch.Core) rewrite (V3), the library provides significant improvements primarily in Memory Allocation and in supporting real multi-threading processing. These improvements are mainly targeted at Sophon, as it primarily uses SharpHPatchZ to update each file to its newer version. Instead of allocating more than 2 GB, the memory allocation is now around **400-700 MB** (as tested in 16-thread systems). You can check out [**this PR**](https://github.com/CollapseLauncher/SharpHDiffPatch.Core/pull/11) for more of that juicy info! :eyes:.

## **[New]** [Game Settings Subsystem Support for Plugin-based Games](https://github.com/CollapseLauncher/Collapse/pull/900), by @Cryotechnic 
We have implemented a new Update 6 extension for the v1 API Standard. The plugin developer can now add customizations to the game into Collapse Launcher. To see the example of the implementation, see the source code of our Wuthering Waves plugin [here](https://github.com/CollapseLauncher/Hi3Helper.Plugin.Wuwa/tree/main/Hi3Helper.Plugin.Wuwa

body:
## 本次更新内容

- 新增本地引用链接（reflink）整理方式，支持复制优先尝试写时复制及自动回退，在支持的文件系统上减少复制耗时和空间占用。
- 订阅新增首次下载与洗版来源记录，修复全集洗版规则、整季资源选择及重复资源退避，减少重复下载和通知。
- 刮削新增季图片写入剧集根目录、图片兼容别名和 Fanart 4K 背景图开关；规范图片格式并复用下载，减少重复请求。
- 完善 115 云盘覆盖、同名文件处理和历史回执恢复，补齐源文件清理的人工复核操作，恢复整理失败后的 AI 接管。
- 修复音乐多碟专辑及发行规格识别，避免音轨混淆和已整理歌曲重复提交；改善 Emby 媒体年份读取。
- 优化 Agent 交互任务与后台服务隔离、流式反馈及 Telegram 最终消息更新，完善飞书资源选择卡片信息。
- 支持从部署 secrets 文件读取敏感配置并避免回写配置文件；新增 Cheaper Inference 提供商，改进 ChatGPT OAuth 刷新和默认模型配置。
- 修复站点连通性检测、分类透传、用户等级与分享率显示，完善站点统计、插件版本历史操作及豆瓣评论布局。
- 修复 DoH 对 CNAME 应答的处理，解析器全部失败后自动冷却并回退系统 DNS，减少重复超时和告警。
- 升级前后端安全依赖与 moviepilot-rust 0.3.10，完善容器系统包更新及镜像基线校验，修复 TMDB 请求超时和跨设备符号链接移动问题。

name: superpowers
body:
This release retunes brainstorming after its rebuild in v7.0.0. Many of you told us, rightly, that the new default questions got annoying fast and felt formulaic. Brainstorming now digs for context before it asks anything, and tries to ask better questions. We expect to keep tuning it, but we think it's better than it was.

It also trims three long skills so they better survive compaction on Claude Code, and changes the issue and PR templates to ask for a summary written by a human.

### Brainstorming

- **It digs for context first.** In an existing project, or when you point it at a spec, plan, or files, it reads them before its first message and doesn't ask what they already answer. (#2560)
- **It tries to ask better questions.** v7.0.0 opened every session the same way: an offer to skip the questions, then a generic question about "the moment you wished this existed." Now, when you've already said what you want, it plays your request back with what it found in the project and asks about the one thing still open. Later questions build on your answers and on what it found, and say what the answer would change. (#2560, #2571)
- **It offers to skip the questions only when it started on its own.** If you asked for brainstorming by name or with `/brainstorming`, it no longer offers to skip it. (#2560)
- **It lays out the approaches and writes a design doc before building.** It presents two or three ways to build the thing, recommends one, and asks you to pick. Then it writes a design doc, a short one for a small change, and builds nothing until you approve it. Some of you saw it skip the doc and start building; in one of our test scenarios, it skipped the doc without asking in 24 of 24 runs before this change and 3 of 24 after. (#2571)

Thanks to @mbcrawfo for opening #2530, and to @katyatitkova, @ertra, @blorenz, @Biomaj, @fsalum, @technicalpickles, @orochi235, @alexxburg, @fcavalieri, @CelesteCunha, and @zzzzz9999 for the reports, transcripts, and testing there.

name: Monica
body:
# Monica for Android 1.0.321

> 发布日期 / Released: 2026-10-21

## 中文

- 统一密码与卡包新建页顶部的模板切换菜单：采用紧凑的内容自适应宽度、左侧类型图标及右侧选中标记，背景统一为更清晰的高层级表面色；支持页面缩放、大字体及长菜单滚动。


- 修复新建与编辑页三点菜单不随“页面缩放”变化的问题：弹出窗口整体继承页面密度，菜单尺寸、圆角、间距、图标和文字同步缩放；保留系统字体大小设置，较长菜单可滚动。

- 附近设备同步的连接诊断按钮居中；已配对设备支持长按／右滑多选及左滑删除，单项与批量删除配对均二次确认并保留本地内容。接收远端删除前预览并弹窗确认，可选择同步删除或仅接收新增和更新；取消、锁定及后台中断不会默认同意删除；按删除版本记住跳过选择，避免重复提示，新的删除版本仍需确认。

- 附近设备同步状态卡移至页面顶部，固定无背景 M3E 指示器搭配高对比度中央文字，在空闲时静止、同步时转动，中央显示当前阶段的实际进度；未知总量不显示虚假百分比。完善准备、等待与重试提示，准备完成后保留完整连接窗口；取消立即反馈并中断可取消的准备及网络任务，保留配对和已保存内容。

- 移除二维码模板编辑表单中标题、内容与备注输入框的底部指示线，聚焦、未聚焦及禁用时均保持完整圆角填充样式。

- 会员卡与积分卡详情新增“查看会员码”，直接使用已保存的会员号，复用现有二维码／Code 128 条形码展示页；保留开头的零与原始文本，不支持条形码的内容仍可查看二维码。

- 修复密码页面列表直接显示银行卡号和笔记内容的问题：卡号预览仅保留末四位（含旧导入条目的用户名／持卡人预览），笔记隐藏中间内容，短笔记全部遮挡；单项与分组卡片统一处理，保留原始数据、搜索及详情。

- 修复密码列表验证码进度条在首次进入或返回前台时从旧进度追赶的问题；立即按当前时间对齐，保留毫秒精度、按秒更新卡片与绘制层平滑动画，共享计时器恢复时重新采样。

- Monica 本地数据库新增“管理原始信息”入口；项目菜单支持单项／批量删除并二次确认，显示当前栏、数据库和所选数量，删除前重新校验数据版本。本地密码与卡片等内容移至回收站。

- 补齐 KeePass、MDBX 与 Bitwarden 文件夹的移动、复制入口，统一使用居中目标选择弹窗；KeePass/MDBX 复用原生树迁移并校验写入，失败保留源内容。Bitwarden 支持同账户内移动和复制，保留加密字段；含附件、通行密钥或组织条目时暂停复制。

- 修复天翼云盘等应用使用本地 file: WebView 登录页时，明确绑定应用或包名的凭据不推荐的问题；仅恢复精确包名匹配，保留缺失域名的浏览器及远程 WebView 保护。

- 修复旧版 KeePass 验证器条目编辑保存后、切换数据库时出现重复项目的问题；保存前恢复原条目身份，无法唯一确认时停止写入，保留独立条目。

- 卡包新增会员卡、积分卡与旅行票证模板，可从新建页顶部菜单切换并保留各模板草稿；支持会员等级、积分余额／到期日、航班／车次、行程时间、航站楼、登机口、座位等字段，提供类型筛选、搜索、详情复制与重新编辑，沿用加密存储、附件及同步机制。#169

- 支持同步 Bitwarden 团队／组织保险库中有权读取的条目及附件元数据，兼容组织密钥与独立条目密钥；编辑回传保留组织、集合和密钥归属，只读或解密失败时保留本地更改并提示。#168

- 修复数据库筛选菜单编辑模式下 KeePass、MDBX、Bitwarden 文件夹无法打开操作弹窗的问题，统一重命名与删除确认，并在成功后刷新文件夹列表。

- 修复附近设备同步“仅接收”模式在等待连接时准备失败的问题，保持仅接收限制，并在现有超时范围内重试手动同步的临时连接失败。

- 修复部分嵌套网页丢失网址导致绑定账号无法推荐的问题；从键盘和主动填充入口打开选择页时复用现有匹配规则推荐已绑定账号。#167
- 修复将 Android 应用包名直接填写在网址字段时无法推荐绑定账号的问题；兼容裸包名和 `androidapp://` 绑定格式，并保留普通网址匹配。#167

- 修复银行卡有效期输入年份首位后光标跳回、后续数字顺序错乱的问题；同步修复密码条目支付信息中的有效期输入，改善粘贴、选区替换和删除时的光标位置。

- 优化自动填充账号操作为 M3E 居中弹窗，分组展示填充、复制和详情操作，支持大字体滚动；新增独立“无障碍填充”，从输入法、系统 Autofill 或磁贴进入均可使用，服务未启用时提供设置入口，并正确返回目标应用填写。

- 统一默认与新增账号密

body: # Zen Stable Release ## Security - https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-111/ ## New Features - Updated to Firefox 158.0.1 - Boosts now have a 'focus' feature, allowing you to concentrate on a specific part of the website. - Windows builds now run with CSIR PGO, improving performance and startup times. All other platforms also have performance improvements. ## Fixes - Mozilla blocked compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates via OneCRL on October 17th. The blocks were distributed to clients via Remote Settings the same day. This update contains the updated OneCRL block list, ensuring clients will block the compromised certificates even if RemoteSettings is disabled by policy or otherwise unavailable in the user's network environment. (Learn More) - Fixed the sidebar hiding when the mouse is still over it. ([#15995](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15995)) - Fixed devtools not appearing on glance tabs. ([#15261](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15261)) - Boosts zap bar will now push the web contents up when activated. ([#13972](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/13972)) - Fixed sidebar scroll being reset when entering fullscreen. ([#14389](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/14389)) - Fixed multiple windows launching on startup on Linux and Windows. ([#12140](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/12140)) - Fixed a crash on Windows when printing or saving a page as PDF while a screen reader or other assistive technology was running. - Fixed an issue where Zen was opening windows on the wrong monitor in multi-monitor setups on Linux. - Fixed multiple media bars appearing when 2 or more tabs are using WebRTC. - Fixed an issue where files dragged into Firefox from other applications were not dropped onto the page on macOS. - Exter

name: Echo-Live
body:
## 新增
- 玻璃（`glass`）和虚空（`void`）主题新增直排样式变体。
  - 直排样式下，文字从上至下书写，从右至左排列。
  - 对话框控制栏会置于右侧。
  - 具有方向性的文本动画会将右侧视为逻辑上方。
  - 行内元素会水平居中对齐，而非横排样式下的基线对齐。表情图片的 `offset` 字段在直排样式下不生效。
- 对话框和历史记录新增 URL 参数 `zoom`，用于设置缩放率，格式为数字，`1` 代表 100% 缩放率。
- 段落格式新增 `speed` 字段，用于设置当前段落的打印速度。
  - 该设置不会影响后续段落的打印速度，后续段落若未设置此字段则恢复初始速度。
  - _开发者注：实际上该功能自从 Echo-Live 发布之初就已由 Echo 提供支持，但该功能此前从未被 Echo-Live 的任何文档提及。_

## 更改
- 同步 Echo v1.2.1 更改。（[更新日志](https://github.com/sheep-realms/Echo/releases/tag/v1.2.1)）
- 修改了多轨道音效播放方式，现在打印音效会优先跟随主轨道打印速度。

name: Capso
body:
Reliability fixes for Quick Access, OCR and translation.

## Fixes
- **Quick Access:** if saving fails (for example, the export folder can't be written), the card now stays open and shows an error, so you can fix the folder and save again. Previously the card closed anyway. ([#367](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/367))
- **Quick Access:** fixed cases where a card could reappear or restart its auto-dismiss timer after being closed during a drag or its entrance animation. Thumbnails are also lighter on memory for very large captures. ([#367](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/367), [#366](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/366))
- **OCR:** on macOS builds where Vision text recognition fails inside the app, Capso remembers the working fallback and uses it directly for later captures, instead of failing first each time. ([#357](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/357))
- **Translation:** provider requests now reuse connections, so repeated translations start faster. ([#365](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/365))
- **Notifications:** toast messages are no longer cut off. ([#369](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/369))

Thanks to @sivyrn for the Quick Access, OCR, translation and image-scaling fixes!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/compare/v1.2.4...v1.2.5

name: dsh-deep-whale
body:
两套皮肤升级到 **0.1.9**，皮肤管理器升级到 **0.1.8**。这轮主要处理手机输入和侧栏、桌面面板遮挡、快捷方式恢复，并完成官方 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 适配。

以下内容按上次发布的 `v0.1.8` 到本次版本的完整差异整理，包含 #204、#206、#209；共覆盖 **6 个 issue 中已验证的修复**。#192、#201 继续保留，等报告者更新后复测。

## 升级前请确认宿主版本

两套皮肤当前支持 **DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`**，最新验收版本为 **0.2.1-rc.2**。本版使用官方布局状态接口，宿主下限已从 0.1.7-rc.1 提高到 0.2.0-rc.2；仍使用 0.1.7 的用户请先升级 DSH，或继续使用支持该宿主的旧版皮肤。

桌面客户端自己的版本号与内置 DSH 版本可能不同，请以实际宿主为准。第三方发行版或移植版还需核对其修改，不能仅凭名字中有 “DSH” 判断兼容性。

## 手机：键盘、会话切换和右侧栏

### 深海女仆工坊

- **修复键盘刚弹出又收回的问题。** 开启输入框滚动显隐时，键盘动画引起的视口变化和页面滚动不再被误判为“向上回看”，避免输入框隐藏后丢失焦点。（#201）
- **修复横屏输入框被挤出屏幕、竖屏长草稿光标被标题遮挡的问题。** 会话页保留浏览器原生的光标避让，首页继续随键盘调整可见区域。极矮横屏和长草稿下优先保证光标可见，完整工具栏可在收起键盘后操作。（#201）
- **修复抽屉偶发吞掉下一次点击的问题。** 在抽屉外按下后取消手势，或没有生成 click 时，不再把旧的防穿透状态带到下一次操作；同一次收抽屉点击仍保留防穿透。（#201）
- **修复手机竖屏右侧栏高度为 0、打开后看不见的问题。** 三种导航模式均已检查，包括 rail 模式展开左抽屉的情况；左右栏同时打开、设置菜单和输入框交互保持正常。（#208）

这次补做了官方 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 下的 **Android 17 真机 + Chrome 155 + 真实豆包输入法** 对照，覆盖键盘反复开关、长草稿、横屏、汉字输入、首页输入和会话切换。iOS、其他浏览器/输入法及 DSHA APK 尚未实测。

## 桌面与阅读界面

- **两套皮肤修复面板误判造成的正文遮挡。** 当客户端在会话外增加包装层时，旧版可能把普通会话当成插件面板，错误铺上阅读底板。现在直接读取官方面板状态，切换会话、插件面板和新会话时正确恢复。（#203；也覆盖 #192 中已确认的同因问题）
- **女仆皮肤修复设置文字被横向截断。** 设置按钮的装饰边框和内边距不再重复占用宽度，窄侧栏中能给文字留下更多空间。已在官方环境及 dataelement DSH Desktop v0.12.0 中验证。（#163）
- 修复女仆皮肤插件页等面板在内部滚动后，整列向上偏移、页头被裁切和底部露出框架的问题。
- 输入框升起、收回时持续保留磨砂效果，减少动画结束时背景突然变雾的跳变。
- 首页与会话页的模型选择按钮统一跟随官方宽度上限，改善长模型名称、版本标记挤掉推理强度文字的问题。

## DSH 0.2.1 适配与细节

- 两套皮肤适配拆分后的输入区统计项，保留各项数字的阅读底面和交互样式；女仆输入框隐藏时，也能正确关闭已打开的统计浮层。
- 女仆皮肤适配新的思考/工具分组标题结构，恢复展开内容的磨砂底、收起行的背景，并消除卡片内标题底色叠加。
- 女仆权限模式图标增加统一配色：只读为深蓝、工作区写入为金色、完全访问为玫瑰色，按钮与菜单保持一致。此项只调整外观。

## 性能与清理

女仆的移动视口处理现在只在窄屏或触摸布局启用。宽桌面调整窗口时，不再反复写入手机视口变量和测量输入卡片；同时简化了菜单相关选择器。

在官方 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1、Chrome 155 的受控测试中，使用 40 轮合成会话、约 4,000 个页面节点，重复三轮相同的窗口缩放操作：

| 指标（三轮平均） | 优化前 | 优化后 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 样式计算总耗时 | 3.04 秒 | 1.98 秒，约减少 35% |
| 主线程任务总时长 | 3.49 秒 | 2.36 秒，约减少 32% |
| 移动视口写入 / 输入卡片测量次数 | 34 / 34 | 0 / 0 |

这些数字对应窗口缩放场景。#202 报告的持续高 CPU 仍未稳定复现，继续跟进，不列为已解决。

另外移除了 5 张已无引用的运行时图片、无用常量和样式、仅内部使用的类型导出，以及已失效的思考扫光规则；素材清单和发行产物已同步。

## 皮肤管理器 0.1

body:
# What's New in v0.6.1

## Shiny new things

- Subscriptions in the Google Play version of Folo are now purchased through Google Play, with Play prices, Restore Purchases and management in the Play Store

## Improvements

- Changes made offline or while the server is unreachable are kept and sent once the connection is back; only changes the server refuses are undone, and the app tells you
- The timeline shows stored entries while its first page loads, and entry content that could not load offline appears once you are back online
- Better iPad and landscape layouts: screens adapt after a window resize or rotation, narrow iPad windows use the phone layout, Social Media posts and the Plan screen keep a readable width, header buttons stay clear of the window controls, and the full-screen player fits in landscape
- Follow links survive sign-in and two-factor authentication, preselect the view they ask for, and replace an earlier link's form
- Links the in-app browser cannot show open in the system, and shared entry, list and profile links point to the right page
- Clearer, translated errors for a failed pull to refresh, slow requests, AI summaries, unfollows, feeds or lists that don't exist, and refused sign-ins
- Tapping the current tab again scrolls its list to the top
- Signing out stops push notifications to the device
- Analytics no longer receives your name, email or handle
- New handles can contain only letters, numbers and underscores

## No longer broken

- Fixed scrolling not marking Social Media posts as read
- Fixed a Social Media post losing its author and time and leaving a blank gap below it
- Fixed a crash when signing out or switching accounts
- Fixed changes failing after signing out, switching accounts or resetting the local database
- Fixed Discover search crashing when first opened
- Fixed Android never installing over-the-air updates
- Fixed newer entries staying hidden under the header at the top of the timeline
- Fixed loading placeholders that k

body: # BoxPlayer v5.0.37 这次更新围绕媒体库浏览与首页管理：分类和收藏项可以更灵活地放到首页，媒体服务器的列表、播放列表和加载状态也得到改进。 ## 媒体库与首页 - 统一分类、系列和播放列表的首页放置菜单，支持自定义显示名称、移除和重命名收藏卡片。 - 优化首页栏目加载和卡片渲染，改善大媒体库滚动时的响应速度。 - 调整详情页标题、类型与评分布局，完善海报菜单、收藏和播放进度操作。 - 改进封面、广播网络和元数据补全，补充媒体来源评分展示。 ## 媒体服务器 - 改进 Emby、Jellyfin 和 Plex 的目录分页与首页内容隔离，减少不同分类间的内容串扰。 - 补充媒体服务器播放列表操作和服务器连接测速入口。 - 初次打开空列表时在内容区中央显示加载图标；加载后续页面时在列表底部显示小图标。 - 优化服务器海报、详情和继续观看信息。 ## 同步与兼容性 - 改进 Trakt 请求和登录状态处理。 - 修正夸克 Cookie 解析的兼容性问题。 ## 下载与验证 安装包由本次发布流水线构建并附于此草稿。macOS、Windows 和 Linux 请按设备架构选择；Apple 平台及 Android / Android TV 的下载入口见[官网](https://xbyvideohub.com/)。 本 Release 先以草稿形式交付，由维护者检查后手动公开。

name: breeze-shell
body:
## 中文

### 功能特性
- **(更新)** 自更新重写为后台流程：启动后定时检查，自动下载并校验文件大小、SHA-256、文件版本与 x64 结构，完成后提示重启资源管理器生效
- **(更新)** 新版本注入后反复崩溃时自动回滚到上一版 `shell.dll`，并把该版本记为坏版本、不再自动升级
- **(更新)** 注入器纳入更新链路：旧的注册表与计划任务启动项自动迁移到规范安装位置，由它接管后续注入
- **(配置)** 设置页按 Fluent 设计重写，主题与动画可直接预览，数值项改用滑杆编辑
- **(诊断)** 用日志页和问题页取代调试控制台，可查看分级日志、配置覆盖项与脚本 / 运行时问题
- **(脚本)** 新增文件与文件夹占用查询，可列出占用进程、结束进程，并支持一次性批量判断
- **(脚本)** 自绘控件可参与菜单键盘导航：获得焦点、接收按键、拿到焦点变化回调，选中行自动滚入视野
- **(脚本)** 控件能力扩展：暴露绝对坐标与鼠标指针样式，新增位图图标控件，菜单尺寸可统计原生菜单项，菜单项支持显隐
- **(脚本)** `flex` 支持 `on_key_down`、换行、最小尺寸、`align-self`、滚动条样式与文本省略号
- **(菜单)** 输入框聚焦时由菜单窗口接管键盘以支持输入法，关闭后归还焦点；回车直接激活首个可见项，嵌入控件首帧即可聚焦
- **(渲染)** 菜单、任务栏、注入器与 JS 控件迁移到事件驱动的 breeze-ui，空闲时不再持续重绘
- **(配置)** 字体改为按字体族名配置并支持回退链与彩色 emoji，新增 `font.locale`（默认优先中文）
- **(配置)** 支持用 `BREEZE_DATA_DIR` 环境变量重定向数据目录

### 问题修复
- **(菜单)** 修复「发送到」子菜单空白，以及菜单里多出用户目录项
- **(菜单)** 修复滚轮与触控板消息被投给焦点窗口后菜单无法滚动
- **(菜单)** 修复掉帧时悬停子菜单瞬间弹出，以及自绘菜单定位时跳到屏幕顶端
- **(菜单)** 修复自绘菜单项的位图图标丢失与背景半透明
- **(菜单)** 菜单文本清理零宽字符，不再出现缺字形方块，非法 UTF-16 也不再抛异常
- **(兼容)** 修复 OneCommander 新建文件夹被重复触发
- **(兼容)** ExplorerFrame 补丁改为只走经典菜单判定并跳过不可读引用，失败时给出告警
- **(兼容)** 不支持 host backdrop 的系统回退到 DWM 亚克力，不再出现空白背景
- **(稳定性)** 菜单 hook 的异常不再逃逸到资源管理器，键盘 hook 异常时正确释放，卸载时还原所有打过的补丁
- **(稳定性)** 修复异步回调与定时器跨线程拷贝引起的崩溃，重复定时器不再丢失回调
- **(稳定性)** 恢复崩溃上报，并由 `shell.dll` 自己记录崩溃归因
- **(配置)** 首次运行不再强制打开调试控制台，配置重载出错不再拖垮文件监视线程，用户目录变量缺失时自动回退
- **(渲染)** 渲染目标初始化失败时跳过本次显示，不再崩溃

### 代码重构
- **(脚本)** JS 控件回调改为脱离渲染循环派发，同时跳过全透明的填充

### 构建系统
- **(构建)** 固定 reflect-cpp 版本以规避 clang-cl 22 的编译 ICE，并让 sentry-native 不再把新增警告当成错误
- **(依赖)** 升级 breeze-js 与 breeze-ui 到最新版本

### 杂项
- **(版本)** 版本号更新

name: Lyrico
body:
> [!TIP]
> 建议同时更新搜索源插件， 新版插件修复了部分源失效及搜索结果不完整的问题，并支持更多元数据字段
> 前往 [插件下载页面](https://github.com/Replica0110/Lyrico-Plugins/releases/latest)进行下载

## ✨ 新功能

- 新增 SaltUI 界面，支持在设置中切换 Miuix 与 SaltUI（PR #198，Commit 2ec684f6）
- 支持多艺术家独立海报，可分别设置、裁剪、保存和调整海报归属，并支持交换归属（Commit a1aab54f、8de67daf、3e1cabec）
- 艺术家详情页新增海报设置，支持将海报写入歌曲或保存到海报文件夹，以及导出、移除内嵌海报（Commit 81eefde9、6fdb5b54）
- 新增艺术家海报大图预览功能（Commit c3969bce）
- 新增批量导出封面，歌词和封面均可导出到指定文件夹或音频同目录（Commit 819d9e4f、073abf5a）
- 新增 APE 音频标签读写支持（Commit 10da0253）
- 回放增益新增采样峰值和真实峰值选项（Issue #188，Commit b9779078）
- 支持解码 ALAC、APE 音频以计算回放增益（Commit f67569a2）
- 本地搜索支持更多标签字段，包括专辑艺术家、流派、作词、作曲和注释等（Commit 1554b4cd）

## 🎨 界面与体验优化

- 将歌词格式转换与歌词整理拆分为独立操作，按句排序支持自定义同一时间点多行歌词的排列与保留方式（Commit a93f13a0）
- 优化海报文件夹和音乐文件夹页面，完善文件夹层级浏览、海报重命名、裁剪及艺术家详情入口（PR #194，Commit 4569ff1d、dda6825a）
- 优化元数据、歌词和封面搜索界面的布局与操作体验（Commit a2672d90）
- 字段歌曲列表改为独立页面，支持在已填写、未填写列表中编辑歌曲和执行批量操作（Commit ecfb420d）
- 为列表、搜索和任务等空状态添加插画与动画，统一加载失败提示（Commit d4b3993e、06ab376f、409eb144）
- 编辑页封面区新增页码圆点指示器，完善设置项与操作菜单图标（Commit 508d0fda、50bbd656）
- 优化批量匹配配置页面；使用文件名匹配时直接采用完整文件名，不再拆分或清洗关键词（Commit 6fb234ae、82774265）

## 🐞 问题修复

- 修复批量计算回放增益时跳过判断不准确的问题，字段缺失或参考响度变更后会重新计算（Issue #189，Commit 3170f008）
- 修复标签缓存残留导致批量操作误判的问题（Commit 608110fc）
- 修复连续拖动同一插件时排序回退的问题（Commit 9856c77e）
- 修复搜索页面的安全区和分页状态问题（Commit a6b61619）
- 修复启动画面的深色模式适配（Issue #191，Commit f8eb02b1）
- 补充开源许可页面的顶部模糊效果（Commit b6ac0a3d）

## ⚙️ 其他更新

- 外部编辑支持 Activity Result 回调，播放器可获取保存结果及原始音频 URI（Commit 0d452bc6）
- 完善关于页面、贡献者列表与项目支持入口（Commit 76357038、409eb144）
- 更新使用指南，补充外部编辑接入文档（Commit f1141596、26e5168c）

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Replica0110/Lyrico/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

body:
## 本次更新内容

- 优化 Emby、Jellyfin、Plex、Navidrome 查询，按首页展示、媒体查重、入库同步等场景获取所需信息，减少不必要的查询与解析开销。
- 修复自动整理音乐时未同步本地封面的问题，按本地音乐封面设置随音乐文件同步封面。
- 修复 TXT、LRC、Lyricsfile 等歌词文件的权限，遵循部署的 UMASK 设置，避免不同用户运行的媒体服务器无法读取歌词。
- 修复热门订阅年份的返回类型，恢复相关数据的正常展示。
- 修复 Transmission 空文件列表被解释为“全部文件”的问题；未匹配到目标集数时保持任务暂停，避免错误下载或排除文件。
- 改进 Agent 执行图、模型与中间件的资源管理，完善构建取消、缓存替换和会话关闭时的回收，避免提前关闭仍在使用的资源。

## 非官方社区构建 / Unofficial community build

这不是仓库作者发布的官方安装包。作者自 2.4.0 起将桌面安装包限制为 Windows-only，Mac 用户停留在 2.3.0。本 dmg 由本仓库的 GitHub Actions 从公开源码构建，可审计、可复现。

This is NOT an official release by the repository author. The author restricted desktop installers to Windows-only since 2.4.0, leaving Mac users on 2.3.0. This dmg is built by GitHub Actions from public, auditable source.

| 项 / Item | 值 / Value |
|---|---|
| 版本 / Version | 2.5.4 |
| 架构 / Arch | arm64 |

### 可信性 / Trust

1. 构建来自当前标签对应的公开源码，可逐行审计。

name: Antigravity-Manager
body:
-   **[Proxy Pool Anti-Leak Hardening, URL Credential Sanitization & Resilient Health Checks] (Fixes #3703, Ref #3323, PR #3706, Thanks to @cubelikeplayDaniel)**:
    -   **Bound Account Direct IP Leak Prevention**: Overhauled bound proxy routing decisions. When an account's designated proxy is flagged as unhealthy, the gateway prioritizes auto-failover to available healthy nodes in the public pool; if no public proxy is available, requests are strictly routed through the bound proxy regardless of its health state (preferring upstream network failure over direct outbound connections), completely eliminating server VPS IP leaks to Google authorization systems and preventing risk-control account bans. (Fixes #3703, PR #3706, Thanks to @cubelikeplayDaniel)
    -   **WHATWG URL Credential Strip Order & Encrypted Ciphertext Protection**: Aligned with the WHATWG URL standard by clearing password before username, ensuring clean credential extraction across HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5h proxies. Furthermore, if cross-machine migration leaves an undecrypted `ag_enc_` password without embedded fallback credentials, the gateway refuses to forward encrypted ciphertext over plaintext HTTP CONNECT headers. (PR #3706, Thanks to @cubelikeplayDaniel)
    -   **Relaxed Health Check Handshake Timeout**: Increased TCP connect timeout from 5s to 10s and total probe timeout to 15s to prevent false-negative health check failures on high-latency or cross-border multi-hop proxy chains during TLS tunnel negotiation. name: snow-apps
body:
# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.3.2

## 更新内容

- **截图与标注更顺手**：多选区可独立吸附，智能选区动画速度可调；形状支持绑定文字标签，序号支持不同笔触风格。修复跨选区空隙的标注丢失和紧凑布局缩放问题。
- **贴图用途更丰富**：支持将文本、Markdown、HTML 和 CSS 文件贴到屏幕；颜色可显示为可交互色卡，滚轮缩放与透明度步长可自定义。
- **识别与保存更方便**：新增识别完成后自动复制文字的截图动作；更新本地 OCR 引擎，减少识别启动开销；保存路径支持时间变量。
- **录屏导出更精细**：减少静止内容的 GIF 文件体积，改进离线视频导出质量，以及裁剪后的画面、音频和时长一致性。
- **稳定性改进**：优化截图、贴图和图片处理的内存释放，修复弹出菜单悬停、颜色行显示和笔触样式问题。

## What's new

- **Easier capture and annotation:** snap individual capture regions, adjust smart-selection animation speed, attach text labels to shapes, and apply stroke styles to numbered markers. Fixes preserve annotations across region gaps and image scale in compact layouts.
- **More useful pins:** pin text, Markdown, HTML, and CSS files; display colors as interactive swatches; customize mouse-wheel zoom and opacity steps.
- **Quicker recognition and saving:** choose a capture action that copies text after recognition. An updated local OCR engine reduces startup work, and save paths now support time variables.
- **Better recording exports:** smaller GIFs for scenes with static content, improved offline video quality, and more accurate trimmed pictures, audio, and duration.
- **Stability improvements:** better memory cleanup for captures, pinned content, and image processing, plus fixes for popup hovering, color rows, and stroke styles.

## 下载选择 / Choose your download

Full 提供全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动 OCR，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。Windows Mini 首次识别时下载 OCR 组件和模型。/ Full includes all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed. Windows Mini downloads OCR components and a model on first use.

name: rikkahub
body:
更新内容:

- 全新界面设计：聊天、设置、助手、服务商、扩展、备份、翻译等几乎所有页面都换了新风格，应用图标和通知图标也一并更新
- 新增媒体创作：在同一处生成图片和视频，接入多家厂商的最新模型，生成结果可以多选后批量保存或删除
- 记忆升级为按文件整理的记忆库，对话结束后自动归纳
- 压缩上下文改为插入总结，不再删除历史消息；输入框旁显示上下文用量，模型可以设置上下文长度
- 对话开始后，模型、思考深度、搜索等设置固定在这个对话上，不再跟着助手变化
- 对话列表可以按创建时间排序，新对话会放进当前打开的文件夹，自动生成标题可以关闭
- 搜索新增 DeepSeek 搜索服务，Claude 服务商可以使用模型自带的搜索
- 翻译页新增翻译历史
- 可以高亮显示引号里的文字
- 编辑消息时可以修改思考内容
- 工作区支持 Alpine 系统，并可复制文件路径
- MCP 服务器配置改为独立页面，改进登录授权的兼容性
- 修复多处崩溃和显示问题，包括快速修改设置时丢失改动、多轮工具调用时用量统计不准、深色模式下引用角标看不清等，启动和滑动也更流畅

Updates:

- Brand-new design: almost every screen, including chat, settings, assistants, providers, extensions, backup and translator, has a new look, along with new app and notification icons
- New Media Creation: generate images and videos in one place with the latest models from multiple vendors, and select several results to save or delete at once
- Memory is now a file-based memory library that is organized automatically after each conversation
- Context compression now inserts a summary instead of deleting past messages; the input panel shows context usage, and models can have their own context length
- Once a conversation starts, its model, thinking level and search settings stay with that conversation instead of following the assistant
- Conversations can be sorted by creation time, new conversations go into the currently open folder, and automatic title generation can be turned off
- Added DeepSeek as a search service, and Claude providers can use the model's built-in search
- Translator now keeps a history
- Text inside quotes can be highlighted
- The thinking content of a message can be edited
- Workspaces support Alpine and can copy file paths
- MCP server settings moved to a dedicated page, with better compatibility for sign-in authorization
- Fixed a number of crashes and display issues, including lost changes when editing settings quickly, wrong usage stats across multi-step tool calls, and hard-to-read citation badges in dark mode; startup and scrolling are also smoother

## Feature Highlight

### Bulk DLL swap

You can now bulk swap DLLs and presets to many games at once thanks to the new bulk swap feature. Find bulk swap in the toolbar on the games page. Thanks to RafaelHGOliveira for adding this functionality.

### Improved performance and reliability

A bug that would cause games library to stop being loaded has been fixed. An additional benefit is that a full library scan is now completed faster. Thanks to Swissola for discovering this issue and implementing a fix.

name: vorssaint-utils
body:
### Summary
A cleaner Dynamic Island, a What's New window that shows what changed in the features you use, and new screenshot editor tools. Also a faster Command Bar, better AI Agents, recordings and window switcher, and many fixes.

### Highlights
- **What's New for the features you use.** After an update, a window shows what changed in the features you use, and the release notes before updating can be turned off. Settings → About → Updates.
- **A cleaner Dynamic Island.** The open island drops page titles and the ⋯ menu, keeps each page's controls beside the camera and plays music in a compact Now Playing player.
- **New screenshot editor tools.** The editor adds a Spotlight tool, canvas expansion and image layers pasted with Command-V.
- **AI Agents for every Codex account.** Limits show for each separate Codex account, and Claude's limits come through Claude Code, so use on other Macs counts. Settings → Dynamic Island → Content → AI Agents.

### Added
- Dynamic Island can show the keyboard input source when it changes. Settings → Dynamic Island → Activity → Indicators.
- Dynamic Island can open and close with a keyboard shortcut. Settings → Dynamic Island → Behavior → Opening.
- Dynamic Island can find covers for YouTube and YouTube Music playing in Firefox, Zen and other Firefox-based browsers. Settings → Dynamic Island → Content → Music → Find covers for Firefox and Zen.
- AI Agents can show limits for each separate Codex account. Settings → Dynamic Island → Content → AI Agents.
- After an update, What's New shows what changed in the features you use. The release notes before updating can be turned off. Settings → About → Updates.
- The screenshot editor adds a Spotlight tool, canvas expansion and image layers pasted with Command-V.
- Screenshot previews can copy the text in a capture when Copy text from screen is installed.
- The window switcher can limit how many items fit in a row. Settings → Window switcher → Options → Maximum columns.
- With Snap windows

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
# MFG Unlock 1.4.5 — Engineering & Reliability

This update builds on 1.4.4 with stronger compatibility checks, safer recovery and more reliable latency controls.

### Improvements

- **Stronger compatibility checks.** Kernel replacements and binary patches verify known content before applying changes. Unrecognized content is refused instead of patched speculatively.
- **Safer rollback and buffer lifetime.** Replacement memory remains allocated while runtime descriptors still reference it, including partial restoration failures.
- **Improved hook reliability.** Installation and removal failures preserve the state needed for recovery.
- **More reliable Latency Guard trials.** Measurements begin after successful application and use fresh, non-overlapping windows.
- **Reduced temporary allocations.** Common module-discovery notifications avoid the previous large heap buffer while retaining long-path support.
- **Clearer performance diagnostics.** PresentMon analysis identifies incompatible metric definitions and presentation modes before comparing results.

Local Stable geometry, V2 Compatibility inpaint, native pacing and the existing HUD/UI behavior are retained. Legacy software pacing profiles were checked on Streamline 2.8 and 2.14.16; unknown binary content uses the conservative fallback.

### Validation

All **42 automated tests passed**. The engineering validation also passed **21 provider patch/restore checks**, **ten complete blend shader compilations**, and numerical photometric and border tests on the GPU.

**In-game validation of this build remains pending.** These checks do not establish an improvement in FPS, displayed frame pacing, image quality or physical latency.

### Installation

Close the game, replace the previous addon with **renodx-mfgunlock.addon64**, keep only one MFG Unlock addon installed, and restart. Your existing configuration can be retained; no INI reset is required.

body:
### Compatibility

- Support DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. Headless profiles resolve vision credentials through the host launch environment when the interactive credential service is disabled; interactive credentials remain authoritative.
- 支持 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`。Headless 禁用交互式凭据服务时从宿主启动环境读取视觉凭据；交互模式仍以凭据服务为准。

### Fixed

- Added actionable writable-session-workspace guidance for permission-denied or read-only workspace-local storage creation. Documented the Windows writable-workspace requirement; storage isolation, the lack of automatic fallback, and the Windows shared-storage ACL restriction remain unchanged (partial follow-up to #169).
- 工作区内存储因权限或只读文件系统无法创建时，错误会提示改用可写会话工作区；补充 Windows 的可写工作区要求。存储隔离、不自动回退以及 Windows 共享存储的 ACL 限制均保持不变（#169 的部分改进）。
- Preserve elapsed upstream time when subprocess startup/collection rejects, including abort paths. Clarify that `timeoutMs` gives queue waiting and execution separate budgets, and that execution covers all upstream attempts and retries. The default timeout and runtime deadline behavior are unchanged (partial diagnostics/documentation follow-up to #166).
- 上游子进程启动或结果收集被拒绝时（包括中止路径）保留已用耗时。明确 `timeoutMs` 分别约束排队与执行，执行预算涵盖所有上游尝试和重试；默认超时和运行时截止行为保持不变（#166 的部分诊断与文档改进）。

Verified host: DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. No official stable DSH version was available at verification time.

name: jellyfin-mpv-shim
body:
This release adds input method support, external bitmap subtitle and audio support, MPRIS (media key) support on Linux, fixes a possible crash when scrolling the library, and makes library filters persistent. Transcoding media with PGS/VOB subtitles doesn't require burning those subtitles in anymore, making transcoded subtitles easier to read. There's also a new theme "Elegance" inspired by the ElegantFin custom CSS theme.

Changes:
- Add MPRIS media controls support for Linux (#129)
  - Full support including next/prev and cover art. Confirmed working with playerctl and KDE connect.
- IME input now works in text fields on Windows and Wayland (#798). X11 is not supported.
- External subtitles and audio
  - External PGS and VobSub (as `*.mks`) files are now playable.
  - Transcodes can extract bitmap subtitles now, making subtitles significantly easier to read on transcodes.
  - Transcode subtitle extraction can be slow, it is done async to avoid hanging the player. If you have problems, either install [Subtitle Extract](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-plugin-subtitleextract) or disable via the `extract_image_subtitles` setting.
  - External audio tracks are supported, this still requires a remux at a minimum.
- Fixed possible app crash during library scrolling (#800)
- Added Elegance theme, inspired by ElegantFin (#805)
- Library
  - Library filters are now remembered by default. You can disable this via a setting.
  - Collections have been added to the Favorites page (#816).
  - HTML and BBCode in descriptions are now removed if your metadata provider adds them.
- Playback
  - Audiobooks are now resumable from tile play button/menus.
  - Music queues now support shuffle.
  - Play queues now update more reliably when updated by a phone or Syncplay.
  - The music volume slider now shows the actual volume not 100%.
  - Trickplay images towards the end of the video now load.

name: Scrapling
body:
**Scrapling v0.5 upgrades almost everything: fetching, parsing, spiders, browser automation, AI tools, and docs in ten languages 🚀**

> [!NOTE]
> **[Follow us on X for daily tips and tricks](https://x.com/Scrapling_dev)**

> [!WARNING]
> **This release introduces a lot of breaking changes that don't fit here. Check the [Migrating to v0.5 guide](https://scrapling.readthedocs.io/en/latest/migrating-to-v0.5.html) before updating.**

## 🚀 New Stuff and quality of life changes

- **A much more capable MCP server for AI agents that can solve almost any CAPTCHA** (Check the [docs](https://scrapling.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ai/mcp-server.html)):

    - **Complete browser workflows**: fill forms, click, hover, scroll, use the keyboard, handle dialogs, and wait for results in one ordered sequence. Supports different field types and slower interactions, with actions stopping at the first error.
    - **Read and search the current page without reloading it**: extract HTML, Markdown, or text from a whole page or one element. Searchable page snapshots show element roles, names, and positions, with focused views that retain the surrounding context.
    - **Run custom JavaScript and take focused screenshots**: execute scripts, including async work, with access to the page's own JavaScript. Capture individual elements, the viewport, or the full page as PNG or JPEG.
    - **Inspect network activity and reuse logins**: examine recorded requests and responses, save and restore browser login state, and interact with elements inside open or closed Shadow DOM. Read recorded traffic before closing the session.
    - **Use fewer tokens and get clearer errors**: leaner tool descriptions and shared guidance reduce repeated text, while browser and request failures reach agents with useful error messages.

- **See the requests behind the page**. Enable `record_requests=True` to record completed traffic across loads, actions, and tabs, then inspect saved responses without sending requests again.

name: Twilight_Echo
body:
# Twilight Echo v1.3.1

_界面退场，音乐继续。_

1.3.1 在 1.3.0 的基础上加入余晖模式、全窗口插件体验与灵动岛，并完善快捷键、页面历史、网络音乐源和原生音频稳定性。此前 1.3.1-preview 中的修复已全部包含在正式版中。

> [!NOTE]
> **对比范围：1.3.0 → 1.3.1 正式版。** 本说明以 **1.3.0 正式版** 为对比基线，包含 1.3.1-preview 的修复与预览期之后合入的改动。

## 本次更新重点

- **余晖模式（Afterglow）**：卸载全部界面渲染器释放内存，由原生音频引擎继续播放；托盘、媒体键、系统媒体控制和局域网遥控仍可操作，随时恢复界面且不中断播放。
- **全窗口插件体验**：插件 API v4 与 bridge v2 预览，插件可以在宿主窗口内提供完整的音乐工作区；Rhine 0.2.1 作为本地预览示例。
- **灵动岛**：宿主拥有的置顶 overlay 窗口，支持跟随主窗口、歌词显示、播放控制和 DIY 配置。
- **可配置快捷键与页面历史**：应用内快捷键可查看占用状态并自定义；鼠标侧键可以在页面历史中前进和后退。
- **网络音乐源与在线内容**：改进 WebDAV 浏览、认证和传输，补齐 FTP／SFTP／SMB／NFS／DLNA 行为；在线歌单支持分组与分页，网易云专辑增加发行筛选与标识。
- **原生音频与诊断**：继续完善 ASIO 设备协商、缓冲与 Native DSD 边界；诊断日志可跨进程持久化，并可恢复卡住的音频服务。
- **性能与内存**：歌曲列表虚拟化与顺滑回到顶部，限制壁纸、封面和主题素材的图片内存，降低长时间使用后的内存占用。

---

## 新增与扩展功能

### 1. 余晖模式（Afterglow）

_把界面收起来，让音乐留在后台。_

- 设置 → **系统与关于 → 运行与性能 → 余晖模式（Afterglow）** 可以立即进入，或选择在最小化／隐藏到托盘时自动进入。
- 进入后渲染器完全卸载，主进程、原生音频服务和（启用时的）GPU 进程继续运行。
- 恢复方式包括托盘菜单、单击／双击托盘图标、`Ctrl/⌘+Shift+E`（冲突时自动回退备用组合）、再次启动应用、Windows 任务栏图标和 macOS Dock。
- 恢复时渲染器采纳引擎的实时队列、曲目、进度、播放态、音量和倍速，不会重新加载队列，也不会打断正在播放的音频。
- 卸载期间仍可使用托盘传输控制、全局快捷键与媒体键、Windows SMTC、局域网遥控、Discord 状态和睡眠定时器。
- 只有原生引擎已完整接管且音源可继续播放时才会进入；流媒体 URL 通过原生队列热更新在后台续接，失败或队列播完会自动恢复界面，不会留下不可见的停止播放器。
- 详细条件、限制与实现位置见 [`docs/afterglow-mode.md`](../afterglow-mode.md)。

### 2. 全窗口插件体验与灵动岛

_插件不再只是侧栏里的一个页面。_

- 插件 API v4 新增 `ui` 类型与 `contributes.experiences`，通过受限的 `plugin-ui://` 协议、CSP 和 iframe 沙箱承载。
- bridge v2 使用一次性 MessagePort 与白名单操作，覆盖曲库读写、播放控制与观察、私有偏好、窗口退出／全屏等能力。
- 插件打开、关闭或替换体验视图不会隐式停止宿主播放；封面等本地资源通过受控句柄访问。
- Rhine 0.2.1 预览展示完整的曲库、队列、歌单、音频／EQ、DSP、下载和设置工作区；托盘、迷你播放器和桌面歌词可使用 Rhine 皮肤。
- 灵动岛通过 `twilight.overlay` 由插件配置，宿主负责窗口生命周期、几何、原生圆角裁剪和配置校验；歌词走独立通道，避免重复序列化。
- 详见 [`docs/plugin-experiences.md`](../plugin-experiences.md) 与 [`docs/dynamic-island.md`](../dynamic-island.md)。

### 3. 快捷键、页面历史与导航

- 应用内快捷键集中配置，并显示注册结果和占用状态，冲突时不再静默失败。
- Windows／Linux 鼠标侧键通过窗口 `app-command` 转发到渲染器的页面历史栈，并对重复投递去重。
- 页面历史与前进／后退状态和现有页面恢复逻辑统一，重启后仍能回到上次浏览位置。

name: motrix-next
body:
## What's Changed

This beta bundles Aria2 Next 3.0.6, which shares a server's connections fairly across downloads and keeps parallel connections for servers that omit Content-Range. Lightweight mode now frees every webview in the tray, the floating orb tells seeding from downloading, and several download and add-window refinements land.

### ✨ New Features

- **Torrent links open their file list** — copying or pasting a `.torrent` link fetches it and shows its files for selection at once (#737)
- **Split archives in their category** — parts such as `.7z.001`, `.z01` and `.r00` are filed with the archive's category (#736)

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Aria2 Next 3.0.6** — downloads from one server share its connections by remaining bytes when the server limits them, so a large video no longer waits behind its audio and subtitles; a `206` without `Content-Range` keeps its parallel connections
- **Lightweight mode frees every webview** — the main window, the prepared add window, the floating orb and its panel all close in the tray, leaving only Rayburst and the engine; they return with the main window (#735)
- **Floating orb** — it fills from the bottom with the overall progress, shows the upload speed while only seeding, and marks connecting, queued and paused states with their sign and percentage; its panel opens centered on it and lists seeding torrents with their upload speed
- **Duplicate prompt from history** — a URL downloaded before is recognized even after its file was moved, renamed or deleted (#545)
- **Clipboard detection** — only links copied after Rayburst started are picked up (#738)
- **Advanced options** — resource type and "save for this site" sit lower, next to the options they belong to

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the floating orb spinning forever while torrents only seed, and the completion check vanishing when a finished torrent starts seeding
- Fixed the main window appearing transparent and empty for a moment on launch and when reopened from the tray

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.15

本版本以修复为主：Windows 上更新后隐藏的应用、配置目录覆盖等设置会被重置为默认值的问题已修复；更新 Codex 时，`--version` 响应慢不会再把好好的 Codex 卸掉；macOS 应用图标改为白色圆角方块，macOS 26 不再把它塞进灰色底板。经路由的请求重新认得出 Claude Code 的会话，走 Codex OAuth 时的缓存键和 Claude Desktop 连 Gemini 时的签名回放都恢复正常；Codex 历史里有一条坏掉的工具调用时不再每轮都报错，DeepSeek 也不再拒收回放的工具历史。另外修复了 WebDAV/S3 慢速传输 300 秒被掐断、Windows 上「打开终端」找不到 `claude`、WSL 里的 Hermes 会话读不出、路由切换总是提示重启等问题。新增用量趋势图的柱形图 / 曲线面积图切换、Hermes 按模型声明图片输入，Claude Desktop 表单也能为 Copilot 等托管登录的供应商获取模型列表。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.15-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.15-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**用量趋势图可以选柱形图或曲线面积图**（[#8406](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8406)）。在用量页「设置」页签的「显示」区，「趋势图样式」可以选柱形图（默认）或曲线面积图，两种样式的指标、坐标轴、悬停提示和币种换算都一样。「显示」区的几项设置也重新排成了对齐的两列，汇率单独一行，放在币种下面。

**Hermes 可以按模型声明支持图片输入**（[#8464](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8464)）。Hermes 按每个模型的 `supports_vision` 判断能不能看图，没写的未知模型会被当成纯文本、图片被压成文字；以前表单里没有地方设置，手写的值保存后也会被冲掉。现在展开模型详情后有「支持图片输入」开关：打开写 `supports_vision: true`，关掉则删除这个键，交给 Hermes 自己判断。从模型列表选到已知支持图片的模型时会自动打开。

**Claude Desktop 可以为托管登录的供应商获取模型列表**（[#8426](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8426)）。GitHub Copilot、Codex OAuth、xAI OAuth 这类供应商以前在 Desktop 表单里没有「获取模型列表」按钮，现在有了，会按登录的账号拉取；还没登录时先提示登录。换了供应商类型或账号后，列表会清空重拉，不会混进别的账号的模型。

## 改进

**路由下切换供应商，提示写明实际做了什么**（[#8347](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8347)）。以前路由模式下切换，Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 总会提示重启客户端。现在提示会说明是记住了供应商、改了路由目标、切换了路由，还是改了聚合默认供应商；只有客户端配置文件确实改了，才提示重启。

**侧栏「今日」不再带「今日」前缀。** 只选一项时也和选两项时一样只显示数值，完整说明在悬停提示里。

**Claude Code 用量导入更快**（[#8224](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8224)）。同一次导入里，查过的模型价格会复用，不再每条记录都查一遍；改了价格，下一次导入就会用上。

**土耳其语**：补齐了卸载和套餐额度相关的新文案（[#8291](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8291)）。

**预设：** 新增 EveryAPI、AllTokens。

# GitHub Stars Manager v0.8.7

## Highlights / 特性亮点

### 1. Vector Search One-Click Interactive Deployment Wizard / 向量搜索跨平台一键部署向导 (#479)
- **EN**: Introducing an end-to-end, cross-platform interactive terminal deployment wizard (TUI) for Cloudflare Worker & Vectorize semantic search. You can now deploy and configure vector search with zero manual Wrangler CLI commands or dashboard clicking!
  - Cross-platform launchers: `npm run deploy:vector`, `./deploy-vector.sh` (macOS/Linux), and double-clickable `deploy-vector.bat` or `deploy-vector.ps1` (Windows).
  - One-click browser OAuth login via Cloudflare Wrangler, automatic index creation, safe secret provisioning, and automatic local config generation.
  - Safe & smart: Automatically preserves existing remote Vectorize indices and auth secrets without data loss.
  - Redesigned Vector Search settings in the app with bilingual step-by-step guidance tabs.
- **ZH**: 推出 Cloudflare Worker 与 Vectorize 语义检索的一键交互式部署向导（TUI）。无需登录 Cloudflare 网页控制台或记忆复杂的 Wrangler 命令即可轻松完成部署与配置！
  - 跨平台便捷启动：支持 `npm run deploy:vector`、`./deploy-vector.sh`（macOS/Linux），以及 Windows 下双击 `deploy-vector.bat` 或运行 `deploy-vector.ps1`。
  - 浏览器一键 OAuth 授权登录、自动创建与探测 Vectorize 向量索引、安全注入鉴权密钥，并自动生成本地配置。
  - 智能安全保障：自动探测并严格保护远端已有的向量索引和密钥，绝不覆盖已有向量数据。
  - 应用内重构了向量搜索设置页，提供清晰明了的中英双语指引选项卡。

Release binaries no longer hand a target repository's `.env` to providers.

### Security

- Release binaries, including the Claude, Codex and Pi provider plugins and the forge-github and chat-slack plugins, no longer load `.env` or `bunfig.toml` from their working directory. In v0.12.0 a provider started in a target repository loaded that repository's `.env` and undid Archon's strip of it, so a project's `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` could reach Claude and override your subscription. Source installs were not affected. If you ran v0.12.0 in a repository whose `.env` holds provider keys, upgrade, then run `archon provider add` again for each provider you use. (#4426, #4427)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://archon.diy/install | bash
```

```powershell
irm https://archon.diy/install.ps1 | iex
```

```bash
brew install coleam00/archon/archon
```

**Docker**
```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" ghcr.io/coleam00/archon:latest workflow list
```

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/coleam00/Archon/releases/latest/download/archon-darwin-arm64 -o /usr/local/bin/archon
```

name: tiez-clipboard
body:
> **测试版**：这是 1.0.0 的测试版，可能还有问题，欢迎在测试群或 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jimuzhe/tiez-clipboard/issues) 反馈。测试版会通过「检查更新」收到之后的测试版和正式版。

**相比 beta.7**：改进 TieZ 对自己写入剪贴板的识别。之前只比对内容，带格式内容（如公式、图片）粘贴时写出的内容和记录不同，会被当成新复制收录，还被记成粘贴目标软件的来源；现在按写入本身识别，粘贴后不再多出多余的记录。「以管理员身份自启」改为不受系统计划任务默认限制（如用电池时不启动、连续运行 3 天后被结束），在笔记本等设备上也能正常生效，下次登录 Windows 时生效。

TieZ 1.0.0 是一次大版本更新，相比上一个公开版本 **Windows v0.3.3（2026-04-11）** 重写了大部分功能。下面按使用场景列出主要变化。

## Windows 专属
- **重装系统后**：数据文件夹从旧系统带过来时，旧系统加密的密码在新系统上无法读取。TieZ 会正常启动，其他设置都在，读不出的那一项在设置里标红色「!」，点开后重新填写；无法打开的旧密钥文件会改名保留（`master.key.dpapi.unreadable`），不会删除。
- **打开文件夹**：不再在成功打开后仍提示「打开失败」。
- **WPS / Excel 带格式粘贴**：剪贴板改为一次写完，不会再被其他程序中途读取打断而粘贴失败；个别格式写不进去时跳过，不影响粘贴。
- **新图标**：换成与 macOS 一致的新图案，圆角、四周透明。
- **外观**：「磨砂」主题在 Windows 11 22H2 及以上改用真正的亚克力模糊，窗口失去焦点后依然保持（需要在系统设置中开启「透明效果」，拖动时可能略卡）；Windows 11 的窗口边框改由系统绘制，四边完整；不透明的内置主题文字更清晰。
- **开机自启**：自启时不再弹出主窗口；新增「以管理员身份自启」（需要确认一次 UAC，用电池时也能生效）。
- **粘贴方式新增「自动」（默认）**：按目标应用选择按键：QQ、Telegram、微信，以及 Chrome、Edge 等 Chromium 内核的浏览器和应用用 Ctrl+V；Windows Terminal 和命令提示符、PowerShell 用 Ctrl+Shift+V；Git Bash、PuTTY、ConEmu、Firefox 等用 Shift+Insert。选择「Shift+Insert」则所有应用都固定用 Shift+Insert。从旧版升级时，原来的默认设置会自动改为「自动」，使用习惯不变。
- **WPS**：收录带格式内容时不再读取链接类格式，避免个别情况下 WPS 崩溃。
- **托盘图标**：设为隐藏后，解锁电脑、远程桌面重连或资源管理器重启时会自动重新隐藏（可能短暂闪现）。
- **Esc**：关闭「方向键选择」后，Esc 依然可以关闭窗口。
- **从 Ditto 导入**历史记录（分组变为标签，快速粘贴文字变为备注）。
- **贴边收纳**：窗口弹出和收起时不再抢走其他软件的输入焦点；贴边收着时退出，下次启动后快捷键可以直接呼出窗口。

## 新功能

**界面**
- **双栏布局**：窗口宽度达到 550 像素后（「双栏预览」，默认开启），左边是记录列表，右边是详情，可以查看文字、表格、图片和文件，常用操作也都在详情里。设置页同样改成左右两栏，中间的分隔线可以拖动；复制规则、标签管理原本就是两栏，这次统一了样式。
- **全新设置页**：按「基础 / 剪贴板 / 同步与传输 / 数据与安全」分组；新安装的默认值重新调整过，老用户升级后保留原来的设置。
- **主题**：新增终端、票据、水墨主题；原来的毛玻璃、纸质书感、3D复古、便利贴改名为磨砂、纸张、复古、便签。「系统」主题可选配色：薄荷、薰衣草、暖橙、樱花（原樱花主题并入这里），也可以自己选颜色。所有内置主题的文字对比度都经过检查。
- **新图标和新音效**。
- **快捷键录制**：只有 Shift 或单个按键的组合会被拒绝，避免吞掉正常输入；macOS 可以录制带 Option 的快捷键。

**剪贴板**
- **贴图**：把图片钉在桌面上，滚轮缩放，Shift+滚轮调透明度。
- **备注**：每条记录都可以写备注。
- **更好的预览**：表格保留原来的颜色、边框和字体；视频显示封面（由系统生成）。在双栏详情里可以直接查看 Markdown、代码等文本文件的内容（显示原文，最多 100 KB），多个文件时可以选择预览哪一个。
- **标签更好用**：输入时列出已有标

## [4.29.1] - 2026-10-17

### 新增

- 网页搜索：“网页搜索” 能力新增 [SerpApi 搜索服务](https://serpapi.com/) (Google 网页搜索、图片搜索、学术搜索、财经搜索)、[DeepSeek 搜索服务](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/search/)（网页搜索、网页内容提取）。 (#10599)
- 插件开发：为插件的单选/多选配置项（list 类型）添加本地化的 `subtitles` 副标题元数据。


### 修复

- ‼️ 电脑使用：修复部分环境（如 Docker 容器环境）下，本地隔离不可用时，无法保存 Local 权限的问题。(#10584)
- 电脑使用：恢复 Windows 下工作区范围内的文件读取、写入和编辑，通过原生文件句柄检查拒绝重解析点和硬链接别名。 (#10584)
- Core：修复开启 “会话隔离” 功能后可能造成的内存泄漏。在注册消息处理流水线之前完成群聊会话隔离，确保运行中的任务及停止请求使用正确的会话。 (#10581)
- Telegram：转换消息时保留隐藏链接。 (#10557)
- Discord：修复全体成员提及。 (#10563)
- WebUI：修复移动端点击插件视图信息后浮层立即关闭的问题。 (#10562)
- Edge TTS：保留原生客户端的 User-Agent，避免请求失败。 (#10588)
- Skills：跳过无法读取的本地及插件技能目录，避免单个目录异常导致整轮 Agent 请求失败。 (#10591)

### Added

- Web Search: Added SerpApi (Google Search, Google Image Search, Google Scholar Search and Google Finance Search) and DeepSeek Search API (web search and page content extraction). (#10599)
- Plugin development: Added localized subtitle metadata for single-select/multi-select configuration options (of type 'list') in plugins.

### Fixed

- ‼️ Computer Use: Restored workspace-scoped file reading, writing, and editing on Windows. Native handle checks reject reparse points and hardlink aliases. (#10584)
- Computer Use: Fixed saving Local permissions when isolation is unavailable. File access remains configurable; execution requiring unavailable isolation is blocked at tool execution. Defaults now give members workspace file access without execution, and administrators entire-environment execution with networking. Legacy Windows member policies with all access disabled migrate once to workspace file access, including identical manually disabled policies because their origin was not stored; later choices remain unchanged. name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**The omo-senpi typecheck gives the same result wherever the checkout sits.** It used to pick up `@types/node` from folders above the checkout, so a stray older copy there failed the typecheck while CI passed on the same commit. omo-senpi now declares its own `@types/node` and `bun-types` and reads type packages only from its own `node_modules`. ([#10320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10320), [#10332](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10332))

**Memory items sync without losing concurrent edits, even from a stale device.** The sync item model captures a device's edits against the exact snapshot it saw, so a stale capture merges as a concurrent edit instead of silently dropping work or throwing; two captures from one device on one baseline lose nothing, multiline and quoted frontmatter values render as valid YAML on every replica, and path keys that would split one file into several (empty segments, trailing slashes, backslashes, drive letters) are rejected instead of canonicalized. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10203](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10203))

**A `categories` entry named after an agent now gets a warning instead of being silently ignored.** A `task(subagent_type: "plan-consultant")` spawn reads only `agents."plan-consultant"`, so a model chain put under `categories."plan-consultant"` never reached it and the spawn ran the builtin chain, while `omo doctor` still counted that category as usable. Whenever a `categories.<name>` key equals a builtin agent or an agent in your `agents` config, and that agent does not already set its own models, the startup notice and `omo doctor` now say that key is not read for that spawn and show the corrected snippet with your own chain, for example `"agents": { "plan-consultant": { "models": [...] } }`; `agents.<name>.models` stays the one way to set an agent's models. Resolution is unchanged. Thanks to @Bearmancer for the report. ([#10323](https://git

body:
MXC SDK v1.0.1 is the first patch for MXC. The stable schema version remains `1.0.0`. 

- Crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/mxc-sdk/1.0.1
- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@microsoft/mxc-sdk/v/1.0.1
- Nuget: [NuGet Gallery | Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk 1.0.1](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk/1.0.1)

See the `Assets` section for `mxc-release-binaries.zip`, which contains signed binaries that can be useful for testing.

## What's Changed

### Behavior changes

- **ProcessContainer:** BaseContainer can reach host services over loopback on PSEC 1.0 hosts when `hostLoopback: "allow"` and the egress policy permit it.
- **ProcessContainer:** `captureDenials` uses option-aware Learning Mode traces where available, and verbose diagnostics include COM activation details.
- **WSLC:** a create-and-run request that combines `wslc.portMappings` with an omitted or all-`deny` `network` block is now rejected during validation. These requests previously failed at container creation.
- **WSLC:** The lifecycle daemon runs executions for up to eight containers concurrently. A second execution against a busy container is refused as `busy`.

### Bug fixes

- **ProcessContainer:** `captureDenials` now reports WFP network denials that were previously dropped because of an outdated provider GUID.
- **WSLC:** Create-and-run execution no longer fails with `HRESULT 0x80070020` while a lifecycle container is provisioned.
- **WSLC:** Create-and-run requests that omit `containerId` no longer fail with `WSLC_E_INVALID_SESSION_NAME`.
- **WSLC:** Lifecycle operations on one container no longer wait behind an execution running in another container.
- **WSLC:** a lifecycle daemon still running from an older install is rejected instead of silently ignoring new fields.
- **Bubblewrap:** DNS resolution works on hosts that use a loopback stub resolver, such as `systemd-resolved`, `dnsmasq`, or Pi-hole.
- **Bubblewrap:** Fixed an intermittent loopback setup failure at san

name: desktop
body:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-106

## New Features
- Updated Firefox to 158.0
- Added a `--space <id|name>` option to the command line interface.
- Library will now show a 'Open in Folder' option and download speed when hovering over the toolbar icon.
- Zen now creates more accessible PDFs when saving a page as PDF, and when printing on Linux and macOS. This also fixes a variety of PDF rendering issues, such as missing math symbols.

## Fixes
- Fixed various animation, urlbar and UI performance issues.
- Fixed Library media tab requesting onedrive to download all files from cloud. ([#15888](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15888))
- Fixed unwanted label next to the search icon in urlbar. ([#14856](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/14856))
- Fixed Avahi access so CUPS printers are listed in flatpak sandbox. ([#9651](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/9651))
- Fixed various memory leak issues. ([#15954](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15954))
- Fixed a crash that could occur while Zen loaded website icons (favicons).
- Fixed menus such as List all tabs, Settings, etc being hard to read with a Windows High Contrast theme. Menu background and text colors now follow the Background and Text colors chosen for a custom contrast theme in Windows Settings.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

## Changes
- Space routing regex will now match URLs as case-insensitive.
- Library's widget hover list will now only display recently downloaded files.
- Zen no longer rounds scroll positions to whole screen pixels. Scrolling is now smoother and more precise, especially on high-resolution displays or when a page is zoomed.

body:
# v3.0.4

Maintenance and DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 compatibility-qualification release. No routing-runtime, schema, public-API, or minimum supported Host change.

## Upstream qualification
- Exact upstream DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 SHA: `1517a4dbca0a2789ff1d41ba439600f8547d23fa`.
- PR #713 passed Windows/macOS/Linux exact-source and Host-Sharp, Node 22/24, Windows/macOS Desktop, real `dsh web` + Chromium cold Vision, mixed attachments, Settings mount/save/reload/readback, bundle recomposition, service injection, and adversarial/legacy Host contracts.
- Published Host window stays `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`.

## Supply-chain upkeep
Consolidates upstream Action pin upgrades from #705–#709: setup-node 7.1.0, upload-artifact 7.0.2, Scorecard 2.5.0, CodeQL upload-sarif 4.38.3 and HOL scanner Action 1.2.786. The exact release-package evidence test is updated along with upload-artifact's pinned version; immutable tarball identity, trusted OIDC and provenance remain required.

## RC1 scope and outstanding issues
DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 has not yet been independently validated: semver admission is not proof of real-Host compatibility. After official release, record exact upstream tag/commit and rerun the full cross-platform source/Host/Chromium/Settings/attachment gate before claiming verified RC1 support.

Issues #684 (historical intermittent Windows alpha2 Vision pointer loss), #703 (DSH Plugin Hub Windows package.json.lock writer contention) and #704 (billion-context coexistence requiring reproduction) remain tracked; none is represented as resolved by this maintenance-only package.

No user configuration or data migration is required. Publication is a separate gated trusted-release workflow and is not performed by this preparation PR.

## Commits

- chore(release): prepare v3.0.4 and consolidate CI action updates (#714)
- test(compat): qualify DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 exact Host and Web lifecycle (#713)
- docs: keep README release badge current for HOL launch (#712)

- 修复 Android Studio 未继承 Rust 工具路径时无法打包的问题，支持自动定位已安装工具和自定义 Cargo 路径。

- 补全附近设备同步的文件夹、根目录附件与独立标签，保留附件身份、扩展数据和来源归属；附件校验失败或不支持文件夹删除时保留受影响的数据并说明原因。

- 修复冷启动或绑定验证器查询超时时，自动填充后偶尔不显示验证码通知的问题；密码填充仍优先完成。

- 修复浏览器访问本机自托管网页时无法匹配已保存凭据的问题，保留应用内嵌页面的兼容行为。

- 升级注册、改密和分步登录的自动填充：已保存密码不会覆盖新密码框，生成密码仅填入新密码与确认框；保存时优先使用新密码，并可确认更新匹配的原条目，保留文件夹、备注、附件和其他账户。

- 无障碍补充填充同样避开新密码与确认框，并校验动态网页的密码写入结果以便必要时重试；再次锁定时立即关闭单独验证过的自动填充保存页。

- 改进验证返回与连续登录，限制临时上下文的来源和有效期；增加可取消的请求时限、缓存失效处理和不含凭据的分阶段耗时诊断。

- 改进自动填充的网页识别：支持浏览器标准化提示，准确区分账号、当前密码、新密码和验证码；网页提供表单结构时仅填充当前表单，保留原生应用和旧网页的兼容逻辑。

- 优化原始数据库管理：名称最多显示两行、双栏独立滚动，支持滑动区间多选、长按菜单，以及跟随当前聚焦栏的底部操作与前进／后退导航；修复普通 MDBX 条目跨格式传输被误拦截。

- 新增 Bitwarden Authenticator CSV 导入，独立入口简称“Bitwarden Auth.”，保留验证器账户及验证码参数。

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. **Select all personal data with one key**: In the personal data list `mo uninstall` opens with D, pressing A selects every path and pressing it again clears them, so removing all of an app's data takes two keys while you still see each path before confirming. 2. **Work with GNU tools first in PATH**: Mole now calls the macOS versions of stat, find, tr, date and du directly, so Homebrew coreutils, findutils or grep earlier in PATH no longer stop `mo clean` with an unbound variable, skip cloud folders, break name search for apps like Écrivain, or fail sizes in Analyze. 3. **Keep game libraries, rollbacks and live system data**: Uninstall never offers the Steam folder that holds your games, Nix cleanup removes only store paths nothing references and keeps your profile generations, and clean leaves every live power log database alone. 4. **Clean old browser builds and device symbols**: Clean removes Chrome builds agent-browser no longer launches, keeping the one it uses or that you pinned, and prunes old macOS and visionOS DeviceSupport versions like the other platforms. 5. **No Xcode install prompt during clean**: Clean leaves the simulator tools alone until Xcode has finished its own first-launch setup, so skipping the admin prompt no longer leads to a system password dialog, and simulator checks show a spinner instead of looking stuck. 6. **Log every change Mole makes**: Dry runs, refused removals, Analyze moves to Trash, Homebrew, launch and login item changes, and package manager cleanups now each leave a row in the operation log, and `mo remove` keeps those logs. 7. **Search and list apps faster**: `mo uninstall ` with hundreds of apps returns in well under a second, and `mo uninstall --list` reads Home

### Highlights

name: iPhoneMirror
body:
这是用于功能和兼容性测试的预览版。

### 新增与改进

- 支持同时录制和直播，可分别停止输出；直播期间可保存或丢弃已完成录制。
- 安装包与便携版内置固定版本的 Personalized DDI 和 iOS 27 Cryptex DDI，使用前校验载荷；Apple 个性化签名仍需联网。
- 设置助手增加工具入口，改进设备绑定、开发者模式引导和错误提示。
- 合并设置助手中的 USB、AirPlay 和蓝牙绑定步骤，打开设备绑定器时自动启动 AirPlay 接收，并支持失败重试。
- 改进 Automation API 的远程文本输入、会话管理、并行输出和启动取消处理。

### 修复

- 改进新设备 USB 描述符与活动配置等待，修正部分设备的显示尺寸映射。
- 改进 Apple USBMux 就绪检测，支持探测商店版 Apple Devices，并提供端口占用诊断。
- 修复 Cryptex/DDI 准备阶段的连接释放、取消和超时处理，打包并校验所需运行时能力。
- 修复预览重绘、键盘焦点、设备切换和媒体输出状态处理问题。
- 修复设备绑定器周期刷新时右侧动画重复播放导致的闪烁。
- 修复 SRS 测试服务的 HTTP 错误处理及多语言资源格式问题。
- 应用与驱动管理器版本统一为 1.8.5-pre3。

### 验证范围

自动构建执行原生、Python、应用逻辑、驱动及本地化检查。GitHub 托管环境不运行需要交互桌面的 WPF 运行时测试。
目标设备上的 Apple 签名、DDI 安装与控制兼容性，以及最终 ZIP/Setup 的完整安装、升级、卸载和实机验收仍需验证；构建通过不代表这些场景已通过。

### Added

- Record and stream simultaneously, stop each output independently, and save or discard a completed recording while streaming continues.
- Bundle pinned Personalized and iOS 27 Cryptex DDI assets in both Setup and portable ZIP builds; Apple personalization still requires network access.
- Add setup tool entry points and improve device binding, developer mode guidance, and error messages.
- Combine USB, AirPlay, and Bluetooth setup into one binding step, start AirPlay reception when the binder opens, and allow retry after startup failure.
- Improve Automation API remote text input, session management, parallel output, and startup cancellation.

### Fixed

- Improve USB descriptor and active configuration readiness checks and correct display size mappings for selected devices.

name: UniGetUI
body:
# Devolutions UniGetUI 2026.3.2

This release adds an experimental Software Catalog and Catalog Editor (turned on in Settings > Experimental), lets you reorder the sidebar pages by drag and drop, brings macOS's new Liquid Glass look to UniGetUI on Mac, and fixes a set of crashes and package manager bugs.

### New Features
* Added an experimental Software Catalog and Catalog Editor, turned on in Settings > Experimental. The catalog is a page of approved software that users can install, update and uninstall in one click. Administrators build it with the Catalog Editor: they can manage several catalogs, pin package versions, and add packages straight from Discover.
* You can now reorder the sidebar pages by drag and drop, or with Alt+Up/Down. Keyboard shortcuts follow the new order, and you can reset it in Settings > User interface.
* UniGetUI on Mac now uses macOS's new Liquid Glass look.

### Improvements
* The package list now keeps its scroll position when an operation finishes, instead of jumping back to the top.
* Package details and "Download installer" now pick the same WinGet installer as installs and updates, following your scope and architecture settings.
* Screen readers now announce the real names of expanders and package list cells instead of control type names.

### Bug Fixes
* Fixed Pip updates that could corrupt the Python environment. Pip operations now run one at a time.
* Fixed PowerShell 7 modules installed for all users that couldn't be uninstalled.
* Fixed Chocolatey packages, such as Python, that need administrator rights not being retried as administrator.
* Fixed several crashes, including at startup, with unreadable icon files, and with screen readers.
* Fixed the restart prompt showing when opening Experimental settings without changing anything.
* Fixed a duplicated top bar and a crash in the terminal UI.

Thank you to everyone who reported issues and contributed improvements to the project.

name: RTX40MFG-Unlock
body:
**V1.5.0-hotfix.1 fixes a VRAM leak when Frame Generation is switched on again.** In The Witcher 3 each switch kept about 425 MiB of video memory until the game was closed. Thanks to Thalixte for the fix ([#80](https://github.com/dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker/pull/80)).

Nothing else changes from V1.5.0. To update, close the game and replace the installed `MFGUnlocker.dll` (or `MFGUnlocker.asi` in `OptiScaler\plugins`) with the new one, keeping its filename. Your settings carry over.

The ZIP contains only **MFGUnlocker.dll**. Press **Backspace** to open the menu (without OptiScaler). See the [README](https://github.com/dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker/blob/v1.5.0-hotfix.1/README.md) for installation, supported filenames and OptiScaler setup. SHA-256 checksums for the ZIP and the extracted DLL are attached.

**Licence note:** `MFGUnlocker.dll` embeds XeSS Frame Generation program data derived from Intel's XeSS SDK. That data is Intel's work, is not covered by the MIT License, and remains subject to Intel's licence terms. See [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker/blob/v1.5.0-hotfix.1/NOTICE.md).

The hotfix DLL passed all 67 local release regression cases (2,455 assertions) and the DLSS Frame Generation 310.9.16 admission checks for RTX 40 and RTX 30. The leak fix was confirmed in The Witcher 3 by its author; an in-game check with this exact DLL is still pending.

body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes backup handling across older Docker daemons and S3, improves health and scheduler reliability, and reduces live-stats rendering costs.

### Backups and storage
- Bind-mount volume subpaths when backing up on daemons older than API 1.45. (#4399) @kmendell
- Send S3 request checksums only when required, improving GCS compatibility. (#4401) @kmendell
- Write S3-only system backups directly to S3 without a local repository. (#4400) @kmendell
- Include the absolute path and UID in project-directory permission errors. (#4404) @kmendell

### Containers, projects, and scheduling
- Report Francis as down when its host exits and extend its health-check deadline. (#4402) @kmendell
- Exclude Swarm task containers from the standalone-container filter. (#4405) @kmendell
- Preserve build image references when Compose fails to load, and document the update-check label. (#4406) @kmendell
- Reset invalid cron settings to defaults at startup. (#4425) @kmendell
- Clear caches when refreshing a workspace. (#4427) @kmendell
- Allow manual updates for services with the updater disabled. (#4430) @kmendell

### Registries, updates, and access
- Retry digest lookups after TLS handshake timeouts. (#4428) @kmendell
- Remove the stale digest name left behind when a frozen pull is tagged. (#4409) @kmendell
- Stop resending image-update push notifications on every poll. (`cd7c39cfcb6c364751d4b55bab887c11b5ebd859`) @kmendell
- Restrict SSH host-key algorithms to entries in `known_hosts`. (#4403) @kmendell
- Match user email lookups without regard to case. (#4429) @kmendell

### Interface and performance
- Fix virtualized table cells being clipped by locking column widths in pixels. (#4407) @kmendell
- Localize settings backup cards and role presets, and prevent long labels from overflowing. (#4408) @kmendell
- Batch live stats by environment to reduce table rendering costs. (`3330f4e0f53bb152cc4720be8ae724cdb1bd8cbb`) @kmendell

name: alt-sendme
body:
### Security

**Please update.** This release fixes a security issue in `iroh-blobs` (updated to 0.103.1). A bug in the provider's event mask meant push requests were accepted even though they were meant to be disabled by default. Any peer able to connect to a provider could write data into its store. The data is content-addressed and verified, so existing blobs could not be modified, but a peer could fill up disk space.

Versions 0.94.0 through 0.103.0 of `iroh-blobs` are affected. Details: https://www.iroh.computer/blog/iroh-blobs-push-fix

### Highlights

- **Security:** Update `iroh-blobs` to 0.103.1 (fixes the push request issue above)
- **Dependencies:** Update `iroh` to 1.3.0 and `rustls` to 0.23.45
- **I18n:** Use the OS language by default

### Bug fixes

- **Tray:** Show the tray icon on Linux by attaching its menu (#329)
- **I18n:** Follow the OS language when it changes and match full language codes
- **I18n:** Keep locale detection working when storage is unavailable
- **Docs:** Update the Vercel program logo to support dark and light themes

### Improvements

- **Docs:** Simplify the HTML structure of sponsor logos in multiple language READMEs

### Dependency updates

- Update `iroh-blobs` to 0.103.1 (#332)
- Update `iroh` to 1.3.0 and `rustls` to 0.23.45 (#333)

* The default ALAC decoder is now from the [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) library. The Hammerton decoder is no longer the default ALAC decoder for Classic AirPlay builds; it remains an option but is strongly deprecated for security reasons.
* A number of memory allocation and out-of-bounds issues have been identified and dealt with. name: DeskBox
body:
DeskBox 1.5.8 keeps DeskBox and Explorer at the same integrity level, and explains accurately when they can't be. Fully elevated desktops — company-managed machines included — no longer see the administrator notice, because drag and drop works there. When the notice does appear, it closes the elevated instance in one click and provides the steps to restart with normal privileges, including how to clear a shortcut's "Run as administrator" checkbox. One-click updates restart the app at the shell's own level, so an elevated machine no longer comes back as administrator after updating. When Explorer itself runs elevated, the app stays usable — the reveal hotkey and settings keep working — and diagnostics can now detect a shortcut-level "Run as administrator" flag.

The maintenance wave lands with it: Todo-widget drags no longer crash; switching groups no longer loses stacked-member icons; cutting a subfolder and pasting it into its parent no longer hangs; auto-organization rules stay enabled across restarts; a repeatedly crashing desktop no longer leaves DeskBox restarting in a loop at sign-in; an update-download failure no longer errors when another dialog is open; and an instance relaunched with normal privileges can be ended by Task Manager without elevation.

## Released

- **Date:** 2026-10-14
- **Version:** 1.5.8
- **Tag:** `v1.5.8`

## Highlights

- **More accurate administrator notices.** The notice now appears only when DeskBox runs above the shell. When it appears, one click exits the elevated instance and the notice walks through restarting with normal privileges — including how to clear a shortcut's "Run as administrator" checkbox. Autostart continues to restart silently with normal privileges. All 12 languages.
- **Updates keep the shell's level.** The updater restarts the app at Explorer's own privilege level whenever the shell offers a standard-user context, so machines that ran elevated no longer relaunch as administrator after a one-click update.
